01Payment and Fintech

E-commerce Workflow

“Buy Now” dabate hi peeche kya hota hai? Supplier se saaman aana, warehouse me rakhna, product list karna, order aana, payment lena, delivery karna — poora e-commerce workflow 16 steps ka hai, 4 bade hisson me: Procurement, Inventory, eComm Platform aur Transportation. Is page me har step deep me — Flipkart/Amazon jaisi companies andar se kaise chalti hain.

1. E-commerce matlab ek sheher ki mandi

Socho ek badi mandi hai. Procurement wale kisanon (suppliers) se sauda karte hain — kya lena hai, kis daam pe. Inventory wale godown me saaman rakhte hain — kya kahan pada hai. eComm platform wali dukaan hai — board pe rate likhna (pricing), sale lagana (promotion), customer se order lena. Transportation wale delivery karte hain — godown se customer ke ghar tak.

Customer ko sirf dukaan dikhti hai — lekin peeche 4 departments ek saath kaam karte hain. Ek department ruke to poora system ruk jata hai.

2. 4 business areas — step by step

Har tab ek area hai — steps ke saath.

Procurement — Steps 1–2: Supplier se saaman lana

Step 1: Procurement department suppliers chunta hai aur contracts karta hai — kaunsa supplier, kya quality, kya daam, kitni quantity.

Step 2: Supplier ko order dena, return manage karna (kharab saaman wapas), aur invoices settle karna (payment).

Kyun important: galat supplier = kharab quality ya late delivery — customer ko pata chale usse pehle hi nuksaan ho chuka hota hai. Procurement hi cost aur quality dono control karta hai.

Inventory — Step 3: Godown ka hisaab

Supplier se aaya saaman storage facility (warehouse) me jata hai. Inventory Management System track karta hai — kaunsa product kahan pada hai, kitna stock hai, kab khatam hoga.

Key problem: stock galat dikha to customer order karega aur saaman milega hi nahi — isliye inventory ka data hamesha accurate hona chahiye. Bade warehouses me robots aur barcode/RFID se tracking hoti hai.

eComm Platform — Steps 4–13: Dukaan ka kaam

Steps 4–7 (Product setup): Product Management system product ki info banata hai → Pricing system daam lagata hai → product sale ke liye list ho jata hai → Promotion system sale, coupons aur offers define karta hai.

Steps 8–11 (Shopping): User app pe register/login karta hai → products browse karta hai → cart me daalta hai → order place karta hai.

Steps 12–13 (Order + Payment): Order Management System inventory me stock reserve karta hai → user payment karta hai.

Interview question (guide se): agar user bahut saare products khareede to bada order chhote orders me bat sakta hai (alag warehouse, alag product type) — “order splitting” system kahan lagayenge? Jawab: Order Management ke baad, payment se pehle — taaki har chhota order apne warehouse se fulfill ho sake.

Transportation — Steps 14–16: Delivery

Steps 14–15: Inventory system transportation system ko outbound order bhejta hai — wo physical delivery manage karta hai (courier, truck, last-mile delivery).

Step 16: Customer delivery pe sign karta hai (optional) — delivery confirm hoti hai, aur return window shuru hoti hai.

Kyun important: delivery hi customer ka aakhri experience hai — late ya tooti delivery poori shopping ko kharab kar deti hai. Isliye logistics pe sabse zyada kharcha hota hai.

3. Poora flow ek table me + order splitting

StepAreaKya hota haiSystem
1–2ProcurementSupplier chuno, order do, invoice settle karoProcurement System
3InventorySaaman warehouse me rakhoInventory Mgmt System
4–7eComm PlatformProduct banao, price lagao, list karo, promotionProduct/Pricing/Promo System
8–11eComm PlatformLogin, browse, cart, order placeApp + Order System
12–13eComm PlatformStock reserve, payment loOrder + Payment System
14–16TransportationDelivery karo, sign loTransportation System
// Order splitting — bada order chhote orders me kab aur kyun?
Order: 5 items — 2 Delhi warehouse se, 3 Mumbai warehouse se
  -> Split: Order-A (Delhi, 2 items) + Order-B (Mumbai, 3 items)
  -> Har chhota order apne warehouse se fulfill hota hai
  -> Customer ko 2 deliveries mil sakti hain (alag-alag din!)

// Kahan lagayein? Order Management ke baad, Payment se pehle:
// Kyunki payment har chhote order ke hisab se alag ho sakta hai
// (ek warehouse ka item cancel ho to sirf uska refund).

Stock reserve kaise kaam karta hai: order place hote hi inventory me stock reserve ho jata hai (kisi aur ko nahi milega), lekin deduct payment success ke baad hota hai. Payment fail ho to reservation timeout pe chhoot jata hai — warna stock hamesha ke liye atak jayega.

4. Try karo — order journey simulator

4. Try karo — order journey simulator

Ek order place karo aur dekho wo 16 steps se kaise guzarta hai — aur beech me kuch gadbad ho to kya hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • Normal order: 1 product
  • Bada order: 5 products, 2 warehouses
  • Payment fail ho gaya
  • Delivery ke baad return

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- E-commerce Order Journey ---

[Normal Order] Step 8-11: Login -> Browse -> Cart -> Order place

  • Step 12: Stock reserve hua (Delhi warehouse, 1 unit)
  • Step 13: Payment ₹1,999 success -> Stock deduct hua
  • Step 14-16: Outbound order -> Courier -> Delivered (2 din) -> Sign done. Order poora!

[Bada Order] 5 products — 2 Delhi se, 3 Mumbai se

  • ORDER SPLITTING: Order-A (Delhi, 2 items) + Order-B (Mumbai, 3 items)
  • Order-A: 2 din me delivered. Order-B: 4 din me delivered. Customer ko 2 deliveries mili.
  • Payment: ek hi baar ₹8,499 — lekin refund alag-alag ho sakta hai per sub-order.

[Payment Fail] Step 12: Stock reserve hua (15 min ke liye)

  • Step 13: Payment FAILED — card decline. Stock reservation timeout pe chhoota.
  • Customer ko dobara try karne ko kaha gaya. Stock kisi aur ko mil gaya — system sahi raha.

[Return] Delivery ke baad customer ne return kiya.

  • Reverse flow: Pickup -> Warehouse check -> Procurement ko return info -> Refund (3-5 din)
  • Refund tabhi jab product sahi condition me wapas aaya — nahi to reject.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Customer ko sirf “Buy” dikhta hai — peeche 4 departments aur 16 steps hain, aur har step pe alag system.

5. 4 areas — zimmedaari aur systems

AreaZimmedaariMain systems
ProcurementSupplier, contract, invoiceProcurement System
InventoryStock, warehouseInventory Mgmt System
eComm PlatformProduct, price, promo, order, paymentProduct, Pricing, Promo, Order, Payment
TransportationDelivery, trackingTransportation System

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Payment se pehle stock deduct karna — payment fail ho to stock gayab. Pehle reserve karo, payment success ke baad deduct karo.
2. Order splitting na karna — bada order ek warehouse se fulfill karne ki koshish karoge to delivery late hogi ya fail hogi. Split karo.
3. Inventory ko real-time sync na karna — do users ek hi aakhri item khareed lein to ek ko cancel karna padega. Stock reserve atomic hona chahiye.
4. Return flow bhoolna — return bhi ek poora reverse workflow hai (pickup, check, refund). Ise pehle se design karo.
5. Payment aur order ko ek hi transaction samajhna — payment alag system hai (PSP), order alag. Dono ke beech idempotency aur reconciliation zaroori hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Buy Now dabane pe peeche kya hota hai?””
A: 4 areas kaam karte hain: eComm platform pe order banta hai → inventory me stock reserve hota hai → payment system paise leta hai → transportation delivery karta hai. Aur peeche procurement ne pehle se supplier se saaman mangwa ke warehouse me rakh diya hota hai. Poora flow 16 steps ka hai.
Q: ““Order splitting kya hai aur kahan lagate ho?””
A: Jab ek order ke items alag-alag warehouses me hon to bada order chhote sub-orders me bat jata hai — har sub-order apne warehouse se fulfill hota hai. Ye Order Management ke baad, Payment se pehle lagate hain — taaki har sub-order ka payment/refund alag track ho sake. Customer ko multiple deliveries mil sakti hain.
Q: ““Stock reserve aur deduct me kya farak hai?””
A: Reserve matlab “ye item tumhare liye rok diya” — kisi aur ko nahi milega, lekin abhi tumhara nahi hua. Deduct matlab “ab ye tumhara ho gaya, stock kam ho gaya”. Reserve order place pe hota hai, deduct payment success ke baad. Payment fail ho to reservation timeout pe chhoot jata hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Customer ne order place kiya lekin payment fail ho gaya. Stock ka kya hona chahiye?

  • ✓ Stock reserve tha jo timeout pe chhoot jaye — deduct sirf payment success ke baad hota hai — sahi jawab
  • Stock turant deduct ho jana chahiye
  • Stock hamesha ke liye reserve rehna chahiye

2. Ek order ke 5 items 2 alag warehouses me hain. Sahi approach kya hai?

  • ✓ Order splitting — 2 sub-orders banao, har ek apne warehouse se fulfill hoga — sahi jawab
  • Ek warehouse se saare items bhejne ki koshish karo
  • Order cancel kar do
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: E-commerce sirf website nahi — 4 departments ka system hai: Procurement saaman lata hai, Inventory rakhta hai, Platform bechta hai, Transportation pahunchata hai. Stock pehle reserve, payment ke baad deduct — aur bade order ko split karo.

02Payment and Fintech

Digital Wallets: Banks vs. Blockchain

Bank ka wallet aur blockchain ka wallet — dono me paise rakhte ho, dono se transfer karte ho. Lekin andar se dono bilkul alag hain. Bank me har bank ka alag khata, settlement shaam ko; blockchain pe ek hi address, settlement turant. Is page me dono ka deposit, transfer aur withdrawal — step by step — aur samjhenge ki VISA aur PayPal blockchain me invest kyun kar rahe hain.

1. Bank wallet matlab alag-alag tijori, blockchain matlab ek global khata

Socho tumhare paas 3 alag bankon me khate hain — har bank ki apni tijori, apna register. Bob ko paise bhejne hain to pehle apne bank ko bolo, wo dusre bank ko shaam ko hisaab bhejega, tab paise pahunchenge. Blockchain matlab ek hi bada register jo sab dekh sakte hain — Bob ka address ek hai, paise bhejo to register me turant likh jata hai, kisi ko shaam tak wait nahi karna.

Bank ka system centralized hai — har bank apna hisaab rakhta hai. Blockchain distributed ledger hai — ek hi hisaab sabke paas hai. Neeche teeno operations dono system me dekhte hain.

2. Bank vs Blockchain — teeno operations

Bob ke $100 se samjho — har tab ek operation hai, dono system me.

Deposit — paise jama karna

Bank me: Bob Bank of America (BoA) jata hai, $100 jama karta hai. Account B1234 banta hai, cash bank ki vault (tijori) me jata hai, wallet me $100 dikhta hai. Citibank use karna ho to wahan alag se account kholna padega — har bank ka alag khata.

Blockchain pe: koi cash nahi — Bob ek address generate karta hai aur private key ko crypto wallet (jaise MetaMask) me store karta hai. Us address pe cryptocurrency receive kar sakta hai — ek address, duniya bhar me kaam karta hai.

Farak: bank me deposit = cash vault me + entry register me; blockchain me deposit = address banao + key sambhalo. Key khoyi to paise gaye — koi “forgot password” nahi hai.

Transfer — paise bhejna

Bank me: Bob BoA app se Alice (Citi) ko $50 bhejta hai. Bob ke account se $50 kat-te hain, Alice ke account me $50 judte hain — lekin asli cash abhi nahi hilta. BoA aur Citi shaam ko (end-of-day) saare transactions ka hisaab karke settle karte hain.

Blockchain pe: Bob MetaMask kholta hai, Alice ka address daalta hai, 2 ETH bhejta hai, aur private key se sign karta hai. Transaction blockchain pe confirm hote hi Bob ke 8 ETH bachte hain, Alice ke 101 ETH ho jate hain — pseudo real-time, koi end-of-day wait nahi.

Asli fark: bank me transfer ek “vaada” hai jo shaam ko poora hota hai; blockchain pe transfer khud hi settlement hai.

Withdrawal — paise nikalna

Bank me: Bob bache $50 nikalta hai — account se kat-te hain, cash haath me milta hai. Simple — kyunki cash vault me pada tha.

Blockchain pe: “withdrawal” ka matlab alag hai — crypto ko fiat (cash) me badalna ho to exchange pe bechna padta hai, phir bank me transfer karna padta hai. Seedha cash nikalna blockchain ka kaam nahi hai — wo exchange aur bank ka kaam hai.

3 bade fark — ek nazar me

1. Ek account vs bahut accounts: blockchain pe ek address se duniya bhar me transact karo; bank me har bank ka alag account chahiye.

2. Settlement: bank me end-of-day (ghante/din), blockchain pe minutes me confirm.

3. Unified interface: blockchain ek hi interface deta hai saare operations ke liye — alag-alag bankon ke alag systems nahi. Isi liye VISA aur PayPal blockchain me invest kar rahe hain — saare bankon ki wallet services ko ek global service me milana possible ho jata hai.

3. Bank vs Blockchain — side by side

CheezTraditional Bank WalletBlockchain Wallet
AccountHar bank me alag (B1234, C512…)Ek address, sab jagah
DepositCash vault me + entryAddress banao, key sambhalo
TransferEntry update abhi, settlement shaam koConfirm hote hi settlement
Settlement timeEnd-of-day (ghante/din)Minutes (pseudo real-time)
ControlBank ke paasTumhare paas (private key)
Key kho jaye toBank se recover ho jata haiPaise hamesha ke liye gaye
FeesBank charges, kabhi-kabhi zyadaNetwork (gas) fee
// Blockchain transfer — andar kya hota hai
// 1. Bob transaction banata hai: {from: Bob, to: Alice, amount: 2 ETH}
// 2. Bob apni PRIVATE KEY se sign karta hai — yehi authorization hai
// 3. Transaction network pe broadcast hoti hai
// 4. Validators confirm karte hain — Bob ke paas 2 ETH hain bhi ya nahi?
// 5. Confirm hote hi ledger update: Bob 10 -> 8 ETH, Alice 99 -> 101 ETH
// Koi bank beech me nahi — ledger hi source of truth hai.

Private key yaad rakh lo: blockchain me tumhari pehchan tumhari key hai. Bank me pehchan tumhara ID + password hai jo bank recover kar sakta hai. Key khoyi = paise gaye. Isi liye hardware wallets aur seed phrases itne important hain.

4. Try karo — wallet simulator

4. Try karo — wallet simulator

Transfer karo — pehle bank se, phir blockchain se — aur dekho time, steps aur settlement me kya fark hai.

Scenarios:

  • Bank: Bob (BoA) -> Alice (Citi), $50
  • Blockchain: Bob -> Alice, 2 ETH
  • Private key kho gayi!

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Digital Wallet Simulator ---

  • Starting: Bob ke paas $100 (bank) aur 10 ETH (blockchain) hain.

[BANK Transfer] Bob ne BoA app se $50 bheje

  • Turant: Bob $100 -> $50, Alice $0 -> $50 (entries update)
  • Asli settlement: SHAAM KO end-of-day — BoA aur Citi hisaab milayenge, tab cash hilega.
  • Time: entries turant, settlement 4-8 ghante. Agar bank band ho to agle din!

[BLOCKCHAIN Transfer] Bob ne MetaMask se 2 ETH bheje, private key se sign kiya

  • Transaction broadcast -> validators ne confirm kiya (2 min)
  • Ledger update: Bob 10 -> 8 ETH, Alice 99 -> 101 ETH. Settlement = confirmation. Koi wait nahi.

[PRIVATE KEY KHO GAYI] Bob ne apni seed phrase kho di.

  • Bank me: branch jao, ID dikhao, password reset — paise safe.
  • Blockchain me: KOI RESET NAHI. 8 ETH hamesha ke liye locked — koi bank, koi support, koi tareeka nahi.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Blockchain tez aur global hai, lekin zimmedaari bhi tumhari hai — key tumhari, paise tumhare, risk bhi tumhara.

5. Kab kaunsa — decision table

ZarooratBank walletBlockchain wallet
Roz ka payment (UPI, card)✅ BestSlow + fees
Cross-border transferSlow, mehenga (SWIFT)✅ Tez, sasta
Ek hi global account❌ Har bank alag✅ Ek address
Password bhoolne pe recovery✅ Bank karega❌ Koi recovery nahi
Regulation / consumer protection✅ Strong⚠️ Limited

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Private key ko screenshot ya cloud me rakhna — key leak = paise gaye. Seed phrase kagaz pe, offline rakho.
2. Blockchain ko bank jaisa samajhna — yahan koi customer care nahi, koi chargeback nahi, koi “forgot password” nahi.
3. Galat address pe bhejna — blockchain transaction irreversible hai. Pehle chhoti amount se test karo.
4. Bank transfer ko “turant” samajhna — entry turant dikhti hai, settlement shaam ko hota hai. Bade amount pe ye fark matter karta hai.
5. Gas fee ignore karna — network busy ho to fee 10x ho sakti hai. Bhejne se pehle fee check karo.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Bank wallet aur blockchain wallet me sabse bada fark kya hai?””
A: Bank me har bank ka alag account hota hai aur settlement end-of-day hoti hai — transfer ek vaada hai jo baad me poora hota hai. Blockchain pe ek hi address duniya bhar me kaam karta hai aur transaction confirm hote hi settlement ho jata hai — koi beech wala, koi wait nahi. Lekin control bhi tumhara hai — key khoyi to paise gaye.
Q: ““Blockchain distributed ledger ka matlab kya hai?””
A: Ek hi register (ledger) jo hazaaron computers pe copy hai aur sab ek saath update hota hai. Koi ek bank register nahi rakhta — network khud rakhta hai. Isliye ek bank band ho bhi jaye to ledger safe rehta hai, aur koi ek party hisaab badal nahi sakti.
Q: ““VISA aur PayPal blockchain me invest kyun kar rahe hain?””
A: Kyunki blockchain saare bankon ki wallet services ko ek global service me mila sakta hai — ek unified interface, ek address, turant settlement. Cross-border payments jo aaj SWIFT se din lagate hain aur mehenga hai, wo blockchain se minutes me aur saste me ho sakte hain.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Bob BoA se Alice (Citi) ko $50 bhejta hai. Asli paise (settlement) kab hilte hain?

  • ✓ End-of-day — bank shaam ko hisaab milake settle karte hain — sahi jawab
  • Turant — bhejte hi cash hil jata hai
  • Kabhi nahi — sirf entries badalti hain

2. Blockchain wallet me private key kho jaye to kya hota hai?

  • ✓ Paise hamesha ke liye locked — koi reset ya recovery nahi hai — sahi jawab
  • Bank se naya password mil jata hai
  • MetaMask khud paise wapas kar deta hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Bank = har bank ka alag khata, settlement shaam ko. Blockchain = ek address, ek ledger, settlement turant. Blockchain tez aur global hai — lekin key ki zimmedaari tumhari hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/digital-wallet-in-traditional-banks-vs-wallet-in-blockchain.md

03Payment and Fintech

What is a Stop-Loss Order and How Does it Work?

Share khareeda $40 pe — gir ke $30 ho gaya to nuksaan $1000 ka. Stop-loss order isse rokta hai: pehle se bata do “$36 pe aate hi bech do” — nuksaan $400 pe ruk jayega. Is page me dekhenge stop-loss kya hai, trading system use kaise execute karta hai, aur iske risks kya hain.

1. Stop-loss matlab car ka airbag

Airbag accident rokta nahi — lekin nuksaan kam karta hai. Stop-loss bhi wahi hai: share girna nahi rokta, lekin nuksaan ko pehle se tay ki gayi limit pe rok deta hai. Tum $40 pe khareedo, $36 pe stop-loss lagao — share $36 pe aate hi system khud bech dega, tumhe screen dekhne ki zaroorat nahi.

Lekin airbag ki tarah iska bhi ek risk hai — kabhi-kabhi airbag chhoti takkar pe bhi khul jata hai. Share $36 ko chhoo ke wapas $45 ho jaye to bhi tumhara share bik gaya — nuksaan pakka. Neeche poora execution flow dekhte hain.

2. Stop-loss ka execution — step by step

Investor ke 100 shares, ABC Inc., current price $40, stop-loss $36. Har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Step 1: Order submit karna

Investor trading system ko stop-loss order deta hai: “mere 100 shares bech do jab price $36 pe aaye”. Ye order turant execute nahi hota — wo trigger ka wait karta hai.

Stop-loss price kaise chunein: bahut paas (jaise $39) rakho to chhoti si girawat pe bik jayega; bahut door ($25) rakho to nuksaan zyada hoga. Aam taur pe 5–10% neeche rakha jata hai — ya technical support level pe.

Step 2–3: Trading engine price monitor karta hai

Trading engine order create karke exchange se ABC Inc. ka live market data subscribe karta hai — har tick pe price check hota hai. Ye monitoring microseconds me hoti hai — price $36 ko chhoote hi trigger hona chahiye.

Kyun important: price tezi se gir raha ho to har millisecond matter karta hai — $36 ka trigger $35.50 pe fill ho sakta hai (neeche dekho — slippage).

Step 4: Trigger — stop-loss market order ban jata hai

Price $35 pe aate hi stop-loss trigger hota hai aur turant ek market order ban jata hai — “100 shares abhi ke best price pe becho”. Ye market order exchange ko submit hota hai.

Important: stop-loss guarantee nahi deta ki $36 pe hi bikega — wo guarantee deta hai ki $36 pe bechne ki koshish shuru hogi. Bikega us price pe jo market me us pal available hai.

Slippage: tezi se girte market me $36 ka trigger $35.50 ya $34 pe fill ho sakta hai — kyunki beech me price aur gir gaya. Isi ko slippage kehte hain.

Step 5: Fill — order execute hua

Exchange order ko best buy orders se match karta hai — aam taur pe turant. Phir trading engine ko fill report milti hai: “100 shares $35.50 pe bike”.

Hisab: khareeda $40 pe ($4000), bika $35.50 pe ($3550) — nuksaan $450. Bina stop-loss ke share $30 pe jata to nuksaan $1000 hota. Stop-loss ne $550 bachaye.

Step 6: Investor ko notification

Trading system investor ko batata hai: “tumhare 100 shares $35.50 pe bik gaye”. Investor ko screen dekhne ki zaroorat nahi padi — system ne khud kaam kiya.

Yaad rakh lo: stop-loss ek risk management tool hai, profit tool nahi. Wo nuksaan limit karta hai — profit guarantee nahi karta.

3. Stop-loss vs limit order + risks

CheezStop-Loss OrderLimit Order
TriggerPrice stop pe aate hiPrice limit pe aate hi
ExecuteMarket price pe (jo mile)Limit price ya behtar pe hi
GuaranteeExecution ki (price ki nahi)Price ki (execution ki nahi)
UseNuksaan roknaProfit pe bechna / saste me khareedna
// Stop-loss ka hisab — ABC Inc., 100 shares
Buy price:    $40.00  (total $4,000)
Stop-loss:    $36.00  (10% neeche)
Trigger hua:  $35.00 pe (market tezi se gira)
Fill hua:     $35.50 pe (best available price)
Nuksaan:      ($40 - $35.50) x 100 = $450
Bina stop-loss (share $30 pe): nuksaan $1,000
Bachat:       $550

// Stop-limit order — dono ka mix:
// $36 pe trigger ho, lekin $35 se kam pe mat becho.
// Risk: $35 se neeche gir gaya to order execute hi nahi hoga!

Stop-limit yaad rakh lo: stop-loss market order banata hai (bikega pakka, price jo mile); stop-limit ek limit order banata hai (price pakka, bikega ye guarantee nahi). Tezi se girte market me stop-limit execute hi nahi ho sakta — isliye beginners ko stop-loss (market) safe lagta hai.

4. Try karo — stop-loss simulator

4. Try karo — stop-loss simulator

Market scenario chuno, phir “Market chalao” dabao — dekho stop-loss kab trigger hota hai aur kitna nuksaan hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • Slow fall: $40 -> $36 -> $35
  • Flash crash: $40 -> $30 ek minute me
  • Fake dip: $40 -> $35.90 -> $45

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Stop-Loss Simulator: 100 shares ABC @ $40, stop-loss $36 ---

[Slow Fall] Price: $40 -> $38 -> $36 (TRIGGER!) -> market order -> fill $35.80

  • Nuksaan: ($40 - $35.80) x 100 = $420. Bina stop-loss ke $30 pe nuksaan $1,000 hota.
  • Stop-loss ne $580 bachaye. Kaam ho gaya.

[FLASH CRASH] Price ek minute me $40 -> $30!

  • Stop-loss $36 pe trigger hua, lekin market order ko fill hone me jo price mila wo $31.20 tha (slippage!)
  • Nuksaan: ($40 - $31.20) x 100 = $880. Stop-loss ne thoda bachaya, lekin slippage ne zyada kha liya.
  • Lesson: tezi se girte market me stop-loss bhi poori tarah nahi bacha sakta.

[Fake Dip] Price $40 -> $35.90 (TRIGGER!) -> fill $35.70 -> phir price $45 ho gaya!

  • Nuksaan: ($40 - $35.70) x 100 = $430 — aur share ab $45 ka hai, jo tumhare paas nahi!
  • Lesson: stop-loss bahut paas rakho to chhoti dip pe bhi bik jayega. Stop ko support level ya 8-10% door rakho.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Market chalao dabao.

SABAK: Stop-loss nuksaan limit karta hai, profit guarantee nahi karta. Slippage aur fake dips iske do dushman hain.

5. Stop-loss lagate waqt kya dhyan rakhein

DecisionSahiGalat
Stop kahan rakheinSupport level ya 8–10% neecheBahut paas (2%) ya bahut door (30%)
Order typeStop-loss (market) — execution pakkaStop-limit — girte market me execute na ho
Position sizeEk trade me capital ka 1–2% riskPoora capital ek trade me
ReviewPrice badhe to stop bhi upar karo (trailing)Ek baar lagake bhool jao

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Stop-loss lagana hi bhoolna — “share wapas upar jayega” soch ke hold karna — aksar nuksaan 10% se 50% ho jata hai.
2. Stop bahut paas rakhna — chhoti si dip pe bik jayega, phir share upar jayega aur tumhare paas nahi hoga.
3. Stop-limit ko stop-loss samajhna — tezi se girte market me stop-limit execute hi nahi hota — share haath me reh jata hai aur girta rehta hai.
4. Stop-loss ko profit tool samajhna — ye sirf nuksaan limit karta hai. Profit ke liye target price alag se lagao.
5. Trailing stop na karna — share $40 se $50 ho gaya to stop $36 pe hi rehna bewakoofi hai — use $44 pe le jao (trailing stop) taaki profit bhi protect ho.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Stop-loss order kaise kaam karta hai?””
A: Investor pehle se ek stop price set karta hai (jaise $36). Trading engine live market price monitor karta hai — price stop pe aate hi order trigger hota hai aur ek market order ban ke exchange ko jata hai, jo best available price pe fill hota hai. Phir investor ko fill report milti hai. Ye nuksaan ko limit karta hai.
Q: ““Stop-loss aur stop-limit me kya farak hai?””
A: Stop-loss trigger hote hi market order banata hai — execution pakka, price jo mile. Stop-limit trigger hote hi limit order banata hai — price pakka (limit se kam pe nahi bikega), lekin execution pakka nahi — tezi se girte market me order fill hi nahi ho sakta.
Q: ““Slippage kya hai?””
A: Trigger price aur fill price ka fark. Stop $36 pe trigger hua, lekin market order fill hote-hote price $35.50 ho gaya — 50 cents ka fark hi slippage hai. Tezi se hilte market me slippage zyada hota hai — isliye stop-loss exact price ki guarantee nahi deta.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. 100 shares $40 pe khareede, stop-loss $36. Price $35 pe aaya aur fill $35.50 pe hua. Nuksaan kitna?

  • ✓ ($40 − $35.50) × 100 = $450 — sahi jawab
  • ($40 − $36) × 100 = $400
  • $0 — stop-loss ne poora bacha liya

2. Tezi se girte market me stop-limit order ka kya risk hai?

  • ✓ Order execute hi nahi ho sakta — price limit se neeche chala gaya to koi khareedne wala nahi — sahi jawab
  • Order hamesha turant fill ho jata hai
  • Stop-limit kabhi trigger hi nahi hota
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Stop-loss airbag hai — nuksaan ko pehle se tay limit pe rokta hai. Price stop pe aate hi market order ban jata hai; fill price slippage ke saath alag ho sakta hai. Stop ko support level pe rakho, bahut paas nahi.

← PichhlaDigital Wallets: Banks vs. BlockchainAgla →What is Web 3.0? Why doesn't it have ads?
04Payment and Fintech

What is Web 3.0? Why doesn't it have ads?

Web 1.0 me tum sirf padhte the. Web 2.0 me tum likhte bhi ho — lekin tumhara data Google-Facebook ke paas hai, aur ads unki kamai hai. Web 3.0 me tum own bhi karte ho — tumhara content, tumhara data, tumhari pehchan. Is page me teeno web generations deep me — aur samjhenge ki Web 3.0 me ads kyun nahi hain (ya kam hain).

1. Web ki kahani — library, mall, aur apna ghar

Web 1.0 ek library thi — kitabein padh sakte ho, kuch bol nahi sakte (read-only). Web 2.0 ek mall hai — tum dukaan bhi khol sakte ho, logon se mil sakte ho, lekin mall ka malik (Google/Facebook) tumhari har harkat dekh raha hai aur usi pe ads bech raha hai. Web 3.0 tumhara apna ghar hai — tumhare paas chaabi hai, tum decide karte ho kaun andar aaye, aur tumhare saaman pe tumhara haq hai.

Web 3.0 ka core idea ek line me: data ki ownership user ke paas — company ke paas nahi.

2. Teen generations — ek-ek karke

Har tab ek generation hai — kya tha, kaise kaam karta tha, aur kya badla.

Web 1.0 — Read Only (1991–2004)

Internet static pages ka catalog tha — ek hyperlink se dusre pe jao, content padho. Koi interaction nahi — comment nahi, like nahi, upload nahi.

Example: 1990s ki company websites — sirf information, “contact us” tak bhi form nahi hota tha aksar. Content sirf website owner banata tha — user sirf padhta tha.

Business model: koi ads nahi, koi data collection nahi — site chalana hi maksad tha, paise kamana nahi.

Web 2.0 — Read + Write (2004–ab tak)

Search engines, social media, recommendation algorithms — user content banane laga: posts, videos, reviews. Lekin ye content companies ke servers pe store hota hai.

Asli business model: apps tumhare behaviour ko digitalize karke data banati hain — kya dekha, kitni der dekha, kya khareeda. Phir ye data advertisements ke liye use hota hai. Isi liye kehte hain — “apps tumhe tumhare doston se behtar janti hain”.

Problem: tumhara data tumhara nahi — company use bech sakti hai, delete kar sakti hai, ya tumhara account band kar sakti hai — aur tum kuch nahi kar sakte.

Yaad rakh lo: Web 2.0 me agar product free hai to tum hi product ho — tumhara attention aur data hi kamai hai.

Web 3.0 — Read + Write + Own

Blockchain aur decentralized apps (dApps) pe based. Tumhara content IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) jaise decentralized storage pe hai — kisi ek company ke server pe nahi. Tumhari pehchan tumhare crypto wallet se hai — koi username-password, koi company tumhe band nahi kar sakti.

Ownership ka matlab: tumhara data tumhara hai. Koi app use karna chahe to tumse permission leni padegi — aur aksar paise bhi dene padenge (tokens). Data bechne ka paisa company ko nahi, tumhe milega.

Web 3.0 me ads kyun nahi hain?

Web 2.0 me ads isliye hain kyunki companies ke paas tumhara data free me hai — wo use ads target karne ke liye bechti hain. Web 3.0 me data tumhara hai — company use bina permission ke dekh bhi nahi sakti, bechna to door ki baat.

Business model badal jata hai: ads ki jagah tokens aur direct payment aate hain — creator ko seedha user se paise milte hain (jaise NFT, subscriptions, micropayments). Beech ka advertiser hat jata hai.

Honest note: Web 3.0 abhi early stage me hai — ads poori tarah khatam nahi hue, lekin model badal raha hai: attention bechne se ownership bechne ki taraf.

3. Teen generations — side by side

CheezWeb 1.0Web 2.0Web 3.0
Time1991–20042004–ab takAbhi shuru
KaamRead onlyRead + WriteRead + Write + Own
ContentStatic pagesSocial media, appsdApps, IPFS
Data kiske paasWebsite ownerCompany (Google/FB)User (wallet)
Business model—Ads (tumhara data)Tokens, direct payment
Pehchan—Username/passwordCrypto wallet
ExampleOld company sitesFacebook, YouTubedApps, NFTs, DAOs
// Web 2.0 vs Web 3.0 — data ka flow
// Web 2.0: Tum -> App -> Company ka server (data yahin rehta hai)
//   Company data bechti hai -> Advertiser -> Tumhe ads dikhte hain
//
// Web 3.0: Tum -> Wallet -> dApp -> IPFS/Blockchain (data tumhara hai)
//   App ko data chahiye? -> Tumse permission + payment
//   Creator ko paise: seedha user se (token/subscription)

IPFS kya hai: InterPlanetary File System — files ko content ke hash se dhoondhta hai, location se nahi. File duniya bhar ke computers pe bikhri hoti hai — koi ek server band ho to bhi file milti hai. Web 3.0 ka storage layer hai.

4. Try karo — tumhara data kahan jata hai?

4. Try karo — tumhara data kahan jata hai?

Ek photo post karo — pehle Web 2.0 me, phir Web 3.0 me — dekho data kiske paas jata hai aur paise kisko milte hain.

Scenarios:

  • Web 2.0: Photo post karo
  • Web 3.0: Photo post karo

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Tumhara Data, Tumhara Paisa ---

[Web 2.0] Tumne photo post ki.

  • Photo: Company ke server pe gayi. Tumhara data: company ne analyze kiya (kahan ho, kya pasand hai).
  • Ads: Tumhe camera ke ads dikhe — company ne advertiser se paise liye.
  • Tumhe mile: 0 rupay. Account band ho to photo bhi gayi.

[Web 3.0] Tumne photo post ki.

  • Photo: IPFS pe gayi — tumhare wallet se linked, tumhari ownership.
  • Koi app photo use karna chahe to tumse permission + payment mangegi.
  • Tumhe mile: logon ne photo ko NFT ki tarah khareeda — paise seedha tumhare wallet me.
  • Koi option nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Web 2.0 me tum product ho; Web 3.0 me tum owner ho. Business model hi badal jata hai.

5. Web 3.0 ke building blocks

BlockKya haiKaam
BlockchainDistributed ledgerTransactions aur ownership ka record
Smart ContractsCode jo khud execute hota haiBina beech wale ke agreements
IPFSDecentralized storageFiles ka storage, kisi ek server pe nahi
Crypto WalletTumhari digital pehchanLogin + paise + ownership
Tokens / NFTsDigital ownershipContent aur assets ki maliki
DAODecentralized organizationCommunity se decisions, CEO nahi

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Web 3.0 ko sirf crypto samajhna — crypto sirf ek hissa hai. Asli idea data ownership aur decentralization hai.
2. “Web 3.0 me ads bilkul nahi hain” samajhna — ads abhi bhi hain, lekin model badal raha hai. Koi bhi claim kare “zero ads” to wo oversell kar raha hai.
3. Seed phrase ko lightly lena — Web 3.0 me tum hi apne bank ho. Key khoyi to sab gaya — koi customer care nahi.
4. Har dApp ko safe samajhna — smart contracts me bugs hote hain aur scams bahut hain. Contract audit aur reputation check karo.
5. Web 2.0 ko “khatam” samajhna — Web 2.0 kahin nahi ja raha. Web 3.0 uske saath chalega — dheere-dheere, specific use cases me.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Web 1.0, 2.0 aur 3.0 me kya farak hai?””
A: Web 1.0 read-only tha — static pages, sirf padhna. Web 2.0 read + write hai — user content banata hai, lekin data companies ke paas hai aur business model ads hai. Web 3.0 read + write + own hai — data blockchain/IPFS pe user ki ownership me hai, aur apps ko use karne ke liye permission + payment dena padta hai.
Q: ““Web 3.0 me ads kyun nahi hote?””
A: Kyunki Web 2.0 me ads ka raw material tumhara data hai jo companies ke paas free me hai. Web 3.0 me data tumhara hai — company use bina permission ke access hi nahi kar sakti. Isliye ads ka model badal jata hai — tokens, subscriptions aur direct payments aate hain.
Q: ““IPFS kya hai?””
A: InterPlanetary File System — ek decentralized storage hai. Normal web me file ko location se dhoondhte ho (kaunse server pe hai); IPFS me file ko content ke hash se dhoondhte ho. File duniya bhar ke computers pe bikhri hoti hai — koi ek server band ho to bhi file mil jati hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Web 2.0 me product free hai to paise kahan se aate hain?

  • ✓ Tumhare data aur attention se — companies data se ads bechti hain — sahi jawab
  • Website owner apni jeb se chalata hai
  • Government deti hai

2. Web 3.0 ki sabse badi pehchan kya hai?

  • ✓ Data ki ownership user ke paas hai — Read + Write + Own — sahi jawab
  • Sirf crypto currency use hoti hai
  • Internet tez ho jata hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Web 1.0 = padho. Web 2.0 = likho, lekin data company ka. Web 3.0 = likho aur own bhi karo — data tumhara, permission tumhari, paise bhi tumhare. Ads isliye kam hain kyunki unka raw material (tumhara data) ab free nahi hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/what-is-web-3.md
← PichhlaWhat is a Stop-Loss Order and How Does it Work?Agla →SWIFT Payment Messaging System
05Payment and Fintech

SWIFT Payment Messaging System

Tum America se London paise bhejte ho — paise kaise pahunchte hain? SWIFT ke through — lekin SWIFT paise nahi bhejta, wo messages bhejta hai. SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication) duniya ke bankon ko jodne wala secure messaging system hai. Is page me uska 17-step message flow deep me — Bank A (New York) se Bank B (London) tak.

1. SWIFT matlab bankon ka registered post

Socho SWIFT ek registered post service hai — wo paise nahi le jata, wo chithhi le jata hai jisme likha hai “Bank A, Bank B ko $1000 do”. Chithhi pehle local post office (Regional Processor) pe validate hoti hai, phir central sorting office (Slice Processor) me store hoti hai, phir dusre sheher ke sorting office se local post office, aur aakhir me Bank B tak. Har step pe receipt (ACK) milti hai — chithhi khoyi to pata chal jata hai.

Paise ka actual movement alag se hota hai (correspondent banks ke accounts se) — SWIFT sirf instruction pahunchata hai. Neeche 17 steps dekhte hain.

2. SWIFT message flow — 17 steps

Bank A (New York) se Bank B (London) — har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Steps 1–5: Bank A se message nikalna

Step 1: Bank A transfer details wala message Regional Processor A (New York) ko bhejta hai — destination Bank B.

Step 2: Regional Processor message ka format validate karke Slice Processor A ko bhejta hai. Regional Processor ka kaam: input validation + output queuing. Slice Processor ka kaam: messages ko safely store aur route karna.

Step 3: Slice Processor A message ko store karta hai. Step 4: Wo Regional Processor A ko batata hai “store ho gaya”. Step 5: Regional Processor A Bank A ko ACK (message jayega) ya NAK (nahi jayega) bhejta hai.

ACK/NAK yaad rakh lo: ACK ka matlab message Bank B ko bheja jayega; NAK ka matlab format ya koi problem hai — message nahi jayega.

Steps 6–8: Message London ki taraf

Step 6: Slice Processor A message ko Regional Processor B (London) ko bhejta hai.

Step 7: Regional Processor B message ko temporarily store karta hai.

Step 8: Regional Processor B message ko ek unique ID deta hai — MON (Message Output Number) — aur Slice Processor B ko bhejta hai. MON se har message ko track kiya ja sakta hai — jaise courier ka tracking number.

Steps 9–12: Bank B tak pahunchna

Step 9: Slice Processor B MON validate karta hai. Step 10: Wo Regional Processor B ko authorize karta hai — “message Bank B ko bhej sakte ho”.

Step 11: Regional Processor B message Bank B ko bhejta hai. Step 12: Bank B message receive karke store karta hai.

Kyun do processors: Regional Processor validation aur queuing karta hai, Slice Processor storage aur routing — dono ka kaam alag hai taaki ek fail ho to dusra sambhal le.

Steps 13–17: Confirmation wapas

Step 13: Bank B UAK (user positive acknowledgment — message bina error ke mila) ya UNK (user negative acknowledgment — checksum fail hua) bhejta hai.

Step 14: Regional Processor B Bank B ke response pe ek report banata hai aur Slice Processor B ko bhejta hai. Step 15: Slice Processor B report store karta hai.

Steps 16–17: Slice Processor B report ki copy Slice Processor A ko bhejta hai, jo use store karta hai. Ab Bank A ko pata chal jata hai ki message Bank B tak pahuncha ya nahi — poora loop band ho gaya.

SWIFT ke baare me zaroori baatein

SWIFT paise nahi bhejta — sirf payment instructions (messages) bhejta hai. Asli paise correspondent bank accounts se hilte hain.

Belgium-based hai, member banks ke dwara chalaya jata hai, aur roz lakhon messages handle karta hai.

Slow aur mehenga kyun: 17 steps, multiple validations, aur beech me correspondent banks — isliye cross-border payment me 1–5 din aur $25–50 fee lagti hai. Isi liye blockchain aur UPI jaisi cheezein SWIFT ko challenge kar rahi hain.

3. Flow ek table me + ACK ka matlab

StepsKahanKya hota hai
1New YorkBank A → Regional Processor A (message bhejo)
2–5New YorkValidate → Slice A store → ACK/NAK Bank A ko
6–8NY → LondonSlice A → Regional B → MON assign → Slice B
9–12LondonMON validate → authorize → Bank B ko message
13LondonBank B → UAK (mil gaya) / UNK (checksum fail)
14–17London → NYReport banao → store → copy Slice A ko
// Acknowledgments ka matlab — ye 4 terms yaad rakh lo
ACK = message Bank B ko bheja JAYEGA (validation pass)
NAK = message NAHI jayega (format/problem hai)
UAK = Bank B ko message BINA ERROR ke mila
UNK = Bank B ko message mila lekin CHECKSUM FAIL (corrupt)

// Poora flow ek line me:
Bank A -> Regional A -> Slice A -> Regional B -> Slice B -> Bank B
   ^                                                          |
   +------------------ UAK/UNK + report wapas ----------------+

4. Try karo — SWIFT message tracker

4. Try karo — SWIFT message tracker

Transfer scenario chuno, phir “Message bhejo” dabao — dekho message 17 steps se kaise guzarta hai.

Scenarios:

  • Normal: $1000, New York -> London
  • Galat format: NAK milega
  • Checksum fail: UNK milega

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- SWIFT Message Tracker ---

  • Step 1: Bank A ne message Regional A ko bheja ($1000, Bank B ko)
  • Step 2-5: Format validate OK -> Slice A ne store kiya -> ACK Bank A ko ("jayega")
  • Step 6-8: Slice A -> Regional B (London) -> MON #482910 assign hua
  • Step 9-12: MON validate OK -> Bank B ko message mila, store hua
  • Step 13: Bank B ne UAK bheja (bina error ke mila!)
  • Step 14-17: Report bani -> store hui -> copy Slice A ko. LOOP BAND.
  • Time: kuch seconds (message ke liye). Paise ka settlement alag se hoga (1-3 din).

[NAK] Step 2: Regional A ne format check kiya — field missing hai!

  • Step 5: Bank A ko NAK mila — "message NAHI jayega, format theek karo".
  • Message Slice tak pahuncha hi nahi. Bank A ko dobara sahi format me bhejna padega.

[UNK] Message Bank B tak pahunch gaya, lekin...

  • Step 13: Bank B ne checksum check kiya — FAIL! Message raste me corrupt hua.
  • Bank B ne UNK bheja. Regional B dobara bhejega ya Bank A ko report jayegi.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Message bhejo dabao.

SABAK: SWIFT paise nahi, message bhejta hai — aur har step pe receipt milti hai, isliye message kabhi “kho” nahi sakta.

5. SWIFT vs naye tareeke

CheezSWIFTBlockchain / UPI-like
Kya bhejta haiMessages (instructions)Value khud (settlement)
Time1–5 din (settlement ke saath)Minutes
Fee$25–50 (beech wale banks)Kam (gas fee)
TrackingMON + ACK/UAKBlockchain explorer
ControlMember banksDecentralized / central bank
Abhi bhi kyun chalta haiHar bank connected haiAbhi har bank connected nahi

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. “SWIFT paise bhejta hai” samajhna — SWIFT sirf messages bhejta hai. Paise correspondent bank accounts se hilte hain — isi liye time lagta hai.
2. SWIFT ko payment system samajhna — ye messaging system hai. Payment system alag hai (clearing + settlement).
3. ACK ko “paise pahunch gaye” samajhna — ACK ka matlab sirf “message jayega”. Paise pahunchne ka confirmation UAK + settlement se milta hai.
4. Cross-border payment ko instant samajhna — SWIFT se 1–5 din lagte hain. Urgent ho to alag rails (jaise Wise, blockchain) dekho.
5. SWIFT ko payment rail samajhna — SWIFT sirf messaging system hai, paise nahi bhejta. Paise correspondent banks ke through settle hote hain — messaging aur settlement alag cheezein hain.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““SWIFT kya hai?””
A: SWIFT Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication hai — duniya ke bankon ko jodne wala secure messaging system. Ye paise nahi bhejta — payment instructions (messages) bhejta hai. Belgium-based hai, member banks ke dwara chalaya jata hai, aur roz lakhon messages handle karta hai.
Q: ““SWIFT message ka flow kya hai?””
A: Bank A message Regional Processor A ko bhejta hai → validate hoke Slice Processor A pe store hota hai → ACK Bank A ko milta hai → message Regional Processor B (London) ko jata hai → MON (unique ID) assign hota hai → Slice Processor B validate karke Bank B ko bhejta hai → Bank B UAK (mil gaya) ya UNK (checksum fail) bhejta hai → report wapas Slice A ko jati hai. Total 17 steps.
Q: ““SWIFT itna slow aur mehenga kyun hai?””
A: Kyunki beech me bahut saare steps aur beech wale banks hain — validation, storage, routing, acknowledgments, aur phir correspondent banks se actual settlement. Har beech wala apni fee leta hai aur apna time lagata hai. Isi liye naye systems (blockchain, UPI-like rails) ise challenge kar rahe hain.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. SWIFT kya bhejta hai — paise ya messages?

  • ✓ Messages — payment instructions; paise correspondent banks se alag se hilte hain — sahi jawab
  • Paise seedha — SWIFT khud paise transfer karta hai
  • Kuch nahi — SWIFT sirf ek bank hai

2. Bank B ko message mil gaya lekin checksum fail hua. Bank B kya bhejega?

  • ✓ UNK — user negative acknowledgment (checksum failure) — sahi jawab
  • ACK — message jayega
  • UAK — bina error ke mila
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: SWIFT paise nahi, messages bhejta hai — 17 steps, har step pe receipt (ACK/NAK/UAK/UNK), aur MON tracking number. Secure hai lekin slow aur mehenga — isliye naye payment rails use challenge kar rahe hain.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/swift-payment-messaging-system.md
← PichhlaWhat is Web 3.0? Why doesn't it have ads?Agla →4 Ways of QR Code Payment
06Payment and Fintech

4 Ways of QR Code Payment

QR code scan karke payment karna roz ka kaam hai — lekin kya tum jante ho iske 4 tareeke hain? Kaun QR dikhata hai aur QR static hai ya dynamic — in 2 sawaalon se 2×2 = 4 combinations bante hain. Paytm, WeChat, Alipay, PayPal — sab yahi 4 tareeke use karte hain. Is page me har tareeka deep me.

1. QR payment matlab do sawaal, chaar jawab

Socho tum dukaan pe ho. Pehla sawaal: QR kaun dikhayega — tum ya dukaan? Dusra sawaal: QR ek hi rahega ya har baar naya banega? Dukaan dikhaye aur QR hamesha ek hi ho — jaise dukaan ke counter pe chipka sticker. Tum dikhao aur QR har baar naya bane — jaise tumhare phone pe har payment ke liye naya code. 2 sawaal × 2 jawab = 4 tareeke. Neeche har ek dekhte hain.

2. Do sawaal — phir 4 tareeke

Pehle do sawaal samjho, phir 4 combinations.

Sawaal 1: QR kaun dikhata hai?

Consumer-presented mode: tum QR dikhate ho, merchant scan karta hai. Merchant tumhare account se direct debit karta hai (paise kaat-ta hai). Example: tumhare Paytm app ka QR — dukaan wala scan kare, paise tumhare account se kat jayein.

Merchant-presented mode: merchant QR dikhata hai, tum scan karte ho. Tum apne account se direct credit karte ho (paise bhejte ho). Example: dukaan ke counter pe chipka QR — tum scan karo, amount daalo, pay karo.

Yaad rakh lo: consumer-presented = merchant paise kaat-ta hai; merchant-presented = tum paise bhejte ho. Dono me paise ka flow ulta hai.

Sawaal 2: QR static hai ya dynamic?

Dynamic QR: har baar naya banta hai — jab tum dikhao to banta hai, ya har kuch second me apne aap badal jata hai. Isme rich info hoti hai — amount, transaction type, order ID. Zyada safe hai kyunki purana QR dobara use nahi ho sakta.

Static QR: ek baar bana, hamesha wahi — aksar sirf account info hoti hai (jaise merchant ka UPI ID). Dukaan ke counter pe chipka sticker static hota hai — tumhe amount khud daalni padti hai.

Security: static QR ko koi copy karke apna sticker chipka sakta hai (QR tampering) — isliye static QR wale payments me amount aur merchant ka naam hamesha check karo.

4 tareeke — 2×2 matrix

1. Consumer-presented + Static: tumhara QR hamesha ek hi — jaise tumhare wallet ka fixed QR. Merchant scan karke debit karta hai.

2. Consumer-presented + Dynamic: tumhare phone pe har baar naya QR banta hai (amount ke saath). Merchant scan kare — sabse safe, kyunki QR kuch second me expire ho jata hai.

3. Merchant-presented + Static: dukaan ka chipka QR — tum scan karo, amount daalo, pay karo. India me sabse common (UPI QR stickers).

4. Merchant-presented + Dynamic: dukaan ka screen pe har customer ke liye naya QR (amount + order ID ke saath) — tum scan karo, amount pehle se bhari hoti hai, bas confirm karo. Malls aur restaurants me common hai.

3. 4 tareeke — comparison table

TareekaKaun dikhata haiQR typeAmount kaun daalta haiExample
Consumer + StaticTumEk hiMerchant (debit)Wallet ka fixed QR
Consumer + DynamicTumHar baar nayaTum (QR me hota hai)Paytm dynamic QR
Merchant + StaticMerchantEk hiTumDukaan ka UPI sticker
Merchant + DynamicMerchantHar baar nayaQR me pehle sePOS screen ka QR
// Dynamic QR me kya hota hai? (UPI example)
upi://pay?pa=shop@okhdfcbank   // merchant ka UPI ID
  &pn=Sharma%20Store            // merchant ka naam
  &am=250.00                    // amount — pehle se bhari!
  &tr=ORDER12345                // order/transaction ID
  &cu=INR                       // currency
// Static QR me sirf pa=... hota hai — amount tum daalte ho.
// Dynamic QR me amount + order ID pehle se hota hai —
// isliye galat amount jaane ka risk kam hota hai.

Security tip: static QR scan karne ke baad hamesha merchant ka naam aur amount check karo — sticker ke upar koi apna QR chipka sakta hai. Dynamic QR me amount pehle se hoti hai aur QR expire ho jata hai — zyada safe.

4. Try karo — QR payment simulator

4. Try karo — QR payment simulator

Tareeka chuno, phir “Pay karo” dabao — dekho QR kaun banata hai, amount kaun daalta hai, aur risk kya hai.

Scenarios:

  • Consumer + Static: tumhara fixed QR
  • Consumer + Dynamic: har baar naya QR
  • Merchant + Static: dukaan ka sticker
  • Merchant + Dynamic: screen pe naya QR

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- QR Payment Simulator: ₹250 ki khareed ---

[Consumer + Static] Tumne apna fixed QR dikhaya. Merchant ne scan kiya.

  • Merchant ne tumhare account se ₹250 debit kiye. QR hamesha ek hi hai — koi photo le le to dobara use kar sakta hai!
  • Risk: MEDIUM — QR leak ho to misuse ho sakta hai.

[Consumer + Dynamic] Tumhare phone pe naya QR bana — amount ₹250 + order ID ke saath, 30 second me expire.

  • Merchant ne scan kiya, ₹250 debit hue. QR expire ho gaya — photo leke bhi koi fayda nahi.
  • Risk: LOW — sabse safe tareeka.

[Merchant + Static] Dukaan ke sticker QR ko tumne scan kiya.

  • Tumne khud amount ₹250 daali aur pay kiya. Sticker pe sirf merchant ka ID hai.
  • Risk: MEDIUM-HIGH — sticker ke upar koi apna QR chipka de to paise galat jagah jayenge. Naam check karo!

[Merchant + Dynamic] Dukaan ki screen pe naya QR bana — amount ₹250 + Order #12345 pehle se bhari.

  • Tumne scan kiya, amount pehle se thi — bas confirm kiya. Payment ho gaya.
  • Risk: LOW — amount galat daalne ka chance hi nahi, QR har customer ke liye naya.
  • Koi tareeka nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Pay karo dabao.

SABAK: Dynamic QR hamesha safe hota hai; static QR me naam aur amount check karna tumhari zimmedaari hai.

5. Kaunsa tareeka kab — ek table me

SituationBest tareekaKyun
Chhoti dukaan, kam budgetMerchant + StaticBas ek sticker print karo — koi device nahi chahiye
Mall / restaurant (POS hai)Merchant + DynamicAmount pehle se bhari, galti kam
Fast checkout (metro, bus)Consumer + DynamicScan karte hi debit, line nahi rukti
Security sabse importantDynamic (koi bhi side)QR expire hota hai, reuse nahi ho sakta

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Static QR pe naam check kiye bina pay karna — sticker ke upar fraud QR chipka ho sakta hai. Hamesha merchant ka naam screen pe verify karo.
2. Dynamic QR ko screenshot karke baad me use karna — expire ho jata hai. Har payment ke liye naya banao.
3. Amount galat daalna (static QR me) — ₹250 ki jagah ₹2500 type ho gaya to refund mushkil hai. Dynamic QR use karo jahan possible ho.
4. Apna consumer QR kisi ko dikhana — consumer-presented QR se merchant tumhare account se debit kar sakta hai. Sirf payment ke time dikhao.
5. QR scan karke bina verify kiye pay karna — hamesha merchant ka naam aur amount check karo. Galat QR ya badla hua amount fraud ka sabse aasan tareeka hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““QR code payment ke kitne tareeke hain?””
A: 4 tareeke — 2 sawaal se bante hain: QR kaun dikhata hai (consumer ya merchant) aur QR static hai ya dynamic. 2×2 = 4: Consumer+Static, Consumer+Dynamic, Merchant+Static, Merchant+Dynamic. Paytm, WeChat, Alipay — sab yahi 4 use karte hain.
Q: ““Static aur dynamic QR me kya farak hai?””
A: Static QR ek baar banta hai, hamesha wahi rehta hai aur sirf account info hoti hai — amount tum daalte ho. Dynamic QR har baar naya banta hai (ya har kuch second me badalta hai) aur usme amount, order ID jaise rich info hoti hai. Dynamic zyada safe hai kyunki purana QR dobara use nahi ho sakta.
Q: ““Merchant-presented aur consumer-presented me paise ka flow kya hai?””
A: Consumer-presented me merchant tumhare account se debit karta hai (paise kaat-ta hai). Merchant-presented me tum merchant ko credit karte ho (paise bhejte ho). Flow ulta hai — isliye dono me risk aur verification alag hota hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Dukaan ke counter pe chipka QR tum scan karte ho aur amount khud daalte ho. Ye kaunsa tareeka hai?

  • ✓ Merchant-presented + Static — sahi jawab
  • Consumer-presented + Dynamic
  • Merchant-presented + Dynamic

2. Sabse safe QR payment tareeka kaunsa hai aur kyun?

  • ✓ Dynamic QR — har baar naya banta hai aur expire ho jata hai, reuse nahi ho sakta — sahi jawab
  • Static QR — ek hi rehta hai isliye safe hai
  • QR use hi mat karo
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: QR payment = 2 sawaal × 2 jawab = 4 tareeke. Kaun dikhata hai aur static hai ya dynamic — yehi decide karta hai amount kaun daalega aur risk kitna hai. Dynamic hamesha safe, static me naam check karo.

07Payment and Fintech

Handling Hotspot Accounts

Amazon Prime Day pe Nike ka sale shuru hota hai — ek hi account pe lakhon orders ek saath. Us account ka balance update karne ke liye database row lock lagta hai — aur saare orders line me khade ho jate hain. Ye hotspot account problem hai. Is page me dekhenge hotspot kya hai aur uske 3 optimizations — rate limiting, sub-accounts aur cache-first updates.

1. Hotspot account matlab ek hi khidki pe poora sheher

Socho ek bank me ek hi khidki hai aur poora sheher wahi aaya hai. Har aadmi ko 2 minute lagte hain — 1000 aadmi hon to aakhri wale ko 33 ghante lagenge. Normal din theek hai — lekin sale wale din ye khidki hi bottleneck ban jati hai.

Solutions: (1) logon ko limit karo — “aaj sirf 100 log” (rate limiting). (2) 10 khidkiyan kholo — har khidki alag hisaab rakhe, shaam ko mila lo (sub-accounts). (3) pehle ek register me likh lo, bank ke system me baad me daalo (cache-first). Neeche teeno detail me.

2. Hotspot kya hai + 3 optimizations

Pehle problem samjho, phir teeno fixes.

Problem — ek row pe saara load

Nike, P&G, Nintendo jaise bade merchants ke accounts hotspot ban jate hain — unpe bahut saare concurrent operations hote hain. Jaise Amazon Prime Day pe Nike ka promotion — lakhon orders ek saath, aur har order Nike ke account ka balance update karta hai.

Normal flow: balance update karne ke liye database row lock lagata hai — ek update chale, baaki wait karein. Lakhon updates line me lag jayein to throughput gir jata hai — system bottleneck ban jata hai. Ek row poori system ko slow kar deti hai.

Numbers: ek row lock pe ~1000 updates/sec ho sakte hain; Prime Day pe 50,000/sec chahiye — 50x ka gap.

Optimization 1: Rate Limiting — line ko control karo

Ek time me kitni requests aane dein, ye limit kar do. Baaki requests ko reject karo ya baad me retry karne ko kaho.

Fayda: bahut simple — system responsive rehta hai (kuch users ke liye), aur DB crash nahi hota. Nuksaan: user experience kharab — reject hue users ko dobara try karna padta hai, aur sale ke time ye bahut bura lagta hai.

Kab use karo: emergency brake ki tarah — jab kuch aur kaam na kare, ya abuse rokne ke liye. Permanent solution nahi hai.

Optimization 2: Sub-accounts me baant do

Merchant ka ek balance account multiple sub-accounts me baant do — jaise Nike ka account 10 sub-accounts me. Har update request sirf ek sub-account ko lock karti hai — baaki 9 abhi bhi free hain.

Fark: throughput 10x badh jata hai — 1000/sec se 10,000/sec. Total balance = saare sub-accounts ka sum.

Challenges: total balance nikalne ke liye saare sub-accounts padhne padte hain; aur ek sub-account me paise kam hon to dusre se “transfer” karna padta hai (rebalancing). Design me ye dhyan rakhna padta hai.

Optimization 3: Cache se balance update karo

Balance update pehle in-memory cache (Redis) me karo — cache lakhon updates/sec handle kar leta hai. Detailed statements aur final balance baad me asynchronously DB me likho.

Fark: throughput 100x — cache DB se bahut tez hai. User ko turant response milta hai.

Risks: cache crash ho to jo updates abhi DB tak nahi pahunche, wo kho sakte hain — isliye cache pe persistence (AOF) lagao, aur DB sync ka gap chhota rakho. Plus, cache aur DB ke beech consistency ka dhyan rakhna padta hai (reconciliation).

Dhyan do: ye write-back jaisa pattern hai — tez hai lekin data loss ka risk hai. Critical money ke liye cache + DB dono ka careful design chahiye.

3. Teen optimizations — comparison

OptimizationThroughputUser experienceRisk
Rate limitingWahi (load kam kiya)Kharab (reject/retry)Kam
Sub-accounts (10x)10xAchhaRebalancing complexity
Cache-first100xSabse achhaData loss risk (crash pe)
Teeno combine100x+AchhaDesign complexity
// Sub-accounts — kaunsa sub-account use karein?
// User/order ID ke hash se chuno — load evenly bat-ta hai
sub_id = hash(order_id) % 10;   // 10 sub-accounts
UPDATE merchant_sub_accounts
  SET balance = balance + 100
  WHERE merchant_id = 'nike' AND sub_id = 3;
-- Sirf sub-account 3 lock hua — baaki 9 free hain!

// Total balance — saare sub-accounts ka sum
SELECT SUM(balance) FROM merchant_sub_accounts
  WHERE merchant_id = 'nike';

// Cache-first — Redis me update, DB me baad me
INCRBY merchant:nike:balance 100   // Redis, microseconds me
// Background job har 5s me DB sync karta hai

Real systems me: teeno combine karte hain — sub-accounts + cache-first + rate limiting as safety net. Alipay aur Amazon aise hi handle karte hain.

4. Try karo — Prime Day hotspot simulator

4. Try karo — Prime Day hotspot simulator

Nike ka Prime Day sale shuru karo — optimization chuno aur dekho kitne orders per second handle hote hain.

Scenarios:

  • Koi optimization nahi
  • Rate Limiting ON
  • Sub-accounts (10) ON
  • Cache-first ON

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Prime Day Hotspot Simulator: Nike account ---

  • Load: 50,000 orders/sec, har order balance update karta hai

[No optimization] Ek row lock — 1,000 updates/sec max.

  • 50,000 me se 49,000 requests wait kar rahi hain. Latency 30s+ — users timeout, orders fail.
  • System bottleneck: ek hi row poori sale ko rok rahi hai.

[Rate Limiting] Limit: 1,000/sec. Baaki 49,000 reject — "dobara try karo".

  • System zinda hai, lekin 98% users ko reject kiya. Sale kharab!

[Sub-accounts x10] 10 sub-accounts — har ek 1,000/sec = total 10,000/sec.

  • Phir bhi 40,000/sec baki hai. Behtar, lekin kaafi nahi. Sub-accounts 100 karo to 100,000/sec!

[Cache-first] Redis pe updates — 100,000+/sec aaram se.

  • Saare 50,000 orders/sec handle hue, latency 5ms. DB sync background me ho raha hai.
  • Risk: cache crash pe unsynced updates kho sakte hain — AOF persistence ON rakho.
  • Koi option nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Sale shuru karo dabao.

SABAK: Ek row ko 50,000/sec mat do — baanto (sub-accounts) ya cache pe le jao. Rate limiting sirf emergency brake hai.

5. Hotspot handle karne ka playbook

StepKya karo
1. PehchanoKaunsi rows hotspot hain? (slow query log, lock waits dekho)
2. BaantoSub-accounts banao — load evenly bat jayega
3. Cache karoHot updates pehle Redis me, DB sync baad me
4. Safety netRate limiting + circuit breaker — system ko bachane ke liye
5. Reconcile karoCache aur DB ka hisaab roz milao (Page 179)

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Hotspot ko “bada DB server” se fix karna — row lock ka problem hardware se nahi, design se solve hota hai. Bada server bhi ek row pe 1000/sec se zyada nahi kar payega.
2. Sirf rate limiting pe bharosa karna — users reject honge, sale kharab hogi. Rate limiting safety net hai, solution nahi.
3. Cache-first bina persistence ke — cache crash = paise ka hisaab gaya. AOF + regular DB sync zaroori hai.
4. Sub-accounts ka total balance bhoolna — har baar sum karna padta hai. Total balance ko bhi cache karo (thoda stale chalega).
5. Hotspot ko pehle se na pehchan-na — Prime Day se pehle load test karo. Sale ke din pata chala to bahut der ho chuki hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Hotspot account kya hota hai?””
A: Ek account jispe bahut saare concurrent operations hote hain — jaise Prime Day pe Nike ka merchant account. Har update pe database row lock lagta hai, to saare updates line me lag jate hain aur throughput gir jata hai. Ek row poori system ki bottleneck ban jati hai.
Q: ““Hotspot ko kaise fix karte ho?””
A: Teen tareeke: (1) Rate limiting — requests limit karo (simple, lekin UX kharab). (2) Sub-accounts — ek account ko 10–100 sub-accounts me baanto, har update sirf ek sub-account lock kare (10–100x throughput). (3) Cache-first — balance pehle Redis me update karo, DB me baad me async sync karo (100x throughput). Real systems me teeno combine karte hain.
Q: ““Sub-accounts ka total balance kaise nikalte ho?””
A: Saare sub-accounts ka sum karo. Ye thoda mehenga hai, isliye total balance ko bhi cache kar lete hain (thoda stale chalega — exact balance sirf settlement ke time chahiye hota hai). Rebalancing bhi karna padta hai — agar ek sub-account khaali ho jaye to dusre se transfer karo.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Prime Day pe Nike ke account pe 50,000 updates/sec aa rahe hain, lekin ek row lock sirf 1,000/sec kar sakta hai. Sabse achha fix kya hai?

  • ✓ Sub-accounts + cache-first — load baanto aur hot updates Redis pe karo — sahi jawab
  • Sirf rate limiting — 49,000 users ko reject kar do
  • Bada database server khareedo

2. Cache-first updates ka sabse bada risk kya hai?

  • ✓ Cache crash ho to jo updates DB tak nahi pahunche wo kho sakte hain — sahi jawab
  • Cache bahut slow hota hai
  • Cache me balance galat ho jata hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Hotspot = ek row pe poora load. Fix: baanto (sub-accounts), cache pe le jao (Redis-first), aur rate limiting sirf safety net rakho. Bada server row lock ko fix nahi karta — design karta hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/handling-hotspot-accounts.md

08Payment and Fintech

Reconciliation in Payment

Tumne $200 me ghadi khareedi — paise gaye, order aaya. Lekin kya website, PayPal aur ledger — teeno me $200 hi likha hai? Agar kisi me $199 ya $201 likha hai to paise kahin atak gaye. Isi check ko reconciliation kehte hain — payment system ka sabse painful lekin sabse zaroori kaam. Is page me uske 3 bade problems aur unke fixes.

1. Reconciliation matlab shaam ko hisaab milana

Socho tum ek dukaan chalate ho. Din bhar cash aaya, UPI aaya, card aaya. Shaam ko tum teen hisaab milate ho: tumhari diary (order records), UPI app ka statement, aur tijori ka cash. Teenon me total ek hona chahiye — agar diary me ₹10,000 aur tijori me ₹9,500 hai to ₹500 kahin gadbad hai — ya to kisi ne galat entry ki, ya paise khoye, ya koi entry doosre din ki hai.

Payment system me wahi kaam croreon transactions pe hota hai — website, payment gateway (PayPal), aur ledger — teeno ke records milaye jate hain. Mismatch mile to use break kehte hain, aur use solve karna hi reconciliation team ka kaam hai.

2. Reconciliation ka flow + 3 problems

Pehle basic flow, phir 3 pain points aur unke solutions.

Basic flow — $200 ki ghadi ka example

Tum $200 me ghadi khareedte ho PayPal se. Teen jagah record banta hai: (1) eCommerce website pe $200 ka purchase order. (2) PayPal pe $200 ka transaction record. (3) Ledger me double-entry bookkeeping — buyer ke account se $200 debit, seller ke account me $200 credit.

Double-entry yaad rakh lo: har transaction ke do sides hote hain — debit aur credit — aur dono ka total hamesha barabar hona chahiye. Agar barabar nahi hai to kahin gadbad hai.

Reconciliation ka kaam hai teeno records ko compare karna aur confirm karna ki amounts match karte hain.

Problem 1: Data Normalization — alag-alag formats

Alag systems me data alag formats me hota hai — ek system me date 2022/01/01, dusre me Jan 1, 2022. Amount ek jagah dollars me, dusri jagah cents me. Currency codes alag, timezones alag.

Solution: compare karne se pehle ek transformation layer lagao — saare formats ko ek standard format me badlo. Dates ko ISO format me, amounts ko cents me, timezones ko UTC me. Phir compare karo.

Interview line: normalization ke bina reconciliation shuru hi nahi ho sakta — pehle data ko ek bhasha me lao.

Problem 2: Massive Data Volume — data bahut zyada hai

Roz croreon transactions — ek-ek karke compare karna impossible hai. Solution: big data techniques use karo. Near real-time reconciliation chahiye to streaming platform (jaise Flink) use karo; end-of-day batch kaafi hai to Hadoop jaisi batch processing.

Yaad rakh lo: har system ko real-time reconciliation nahi chahiye — most payments end-of-day batch me reconcile hote hain. Real-time sirf fraud detection jaise critical kaam ke liye hai.

Problem 3: Cut-off Time Issue — din ki boundary

Daily cut-off 00:00:00 hai. Ek record internal system me 23:59:55 pe stamp hua, lekin PayPal me 00:00:30 pe (agle din). Aaj ke PayPal records me wo record milega hi nahi — mismatch dikhega, jabki paise theek hain.

Solution: aise mismatch ko “temporary break” bolo — aur use agle din ke PayPal records se dobara match karo. Mil gaya to break clear — koi action nahi chahiye. Nahi mila to asli problem hai.

Lesson: har mismatch fraud nahi hota — bahut se timing ke wajah se hote hain. Isliye temporary breaks ka alag handling chahiye.

Reconciliation kyun zaroori hai — exactly-once hone ke baad bhi?

Tum kahoge — “agar system exactly-once hai to discrepancy kyun hogi?” Sach ye hai: bahut saari jagah gadbad ho sakti hai — network timeout, partial failure, third-party ka bug, timezone issue, manual entry. Exactly-once theory me hai, real world me nahi.

Reconciliation ek safety net hai — jaise seat belt. Accident na ho to bhi pehno, kyunki ek baar gadbad hui to paise ka sawaal hai. Iske bina tum chain se so nahi sakte.

3. Double-entry bookkeeping + break types

System$200 ghadi ke liye record
eCommerce websitePurchase order: $200 (buyer → seller)
PayPalTransaction: $200
Ledger (double-entry)Debit buyer $200, Credit seller $200
Break typeMatlabKya karte hain
Temporary breakTiming issue (cut-off) — agle din mil jayegaAgle din ke records se dobara match karo
Permanent breakAsli mismatch — amount ya missing recordManual investigation + adjustment entry
DuplicateEk hi transaction do baarIdempotency check + ek ko reverse karo
MissingEk system me record hi nahiSource system se dobara lao ya manual entry
// Double-entry — har transaction ke do sides
// Buyer ne $200 ki ghadi khareedi:
Ledger:
  Debit:  Buyer account   $200   (buyer se gaya)
  Credit: Seller account  $200   (seller ko mila)
// Total debits == Total credits, hamesha.
// Agar barabar nahi, to ledger me gadbad hai — reconciliation use pakdega.

4. Try karo — reconciliation simulator

4. Try karo — reconciliation simulator

Ek din ke transactions reconcile karo — dekho kaunse match hote hain aur kaunse break bante hain.

Scenarios:

  • Normal din: 10,000 transactions
  • Cut-off issue: raat 12 baje wale
  • Duplicate: ek payment 2 baar
  • Missing: PayPal me record nahi

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Reconciliation Simulator: 1 din ka hisaab ---

[Normal Din] 10,000 transactions compare ki (website vs PayPal vs Ledger).

  • Matched: 9,997 | Breaks: 3 (0.03%) — sab chhote timing issues, agle din clear ho jayenge.
  • Status: HEALTHY. Roz 0.03% breaks normal hain.

[Cut-off Issue] 5 transactions 23:59:55 (internal) vs 00:00:30 (PayPal) pe stamp hue.

  • Aaj ke hisaab me 5 TEMPORARY BREAKS — paise theek hain, sirf din alag hai.
  • Action: inhe agle din ke PayPal records se match karo — mil jayenge to auto-clear.

[DUPLICATE] Order #8841 ka payment 2 baar ho gaya — $200 x 2 = $400 kat gaye!

  • Reconciliation ne pakda: website me 1 order, PayPal me 2 transactions.
  • Action: ek payment ko reverse karo (refund $200) + idempotency check lagao taaki dobara na ho.

[MISSING] Order #9012 website pe hai, lekin PayPal me record nahi!

  • Possible: PayPal ka webhook fail hua, ya payment atak gaya. Paise kahan hain?
  • Action: PayPal se dobara status poochho; nahi mila to manual investigation — ye PERMANENT BREAK hai.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Reconcile karo dabao.

SABAK: Reconciliation safety net hai — chhote breaks roz hote hain, lekin duplicate aur missing ko turant pakadna zaroori hai.

5. Reconciliation kab aur kaise

StyleKabToolExample
Real-time (streaming)Fraud ya critical paymentsFlinkHar transaction aate hi match karo
End-of-day batchMost paymentsHadoop / SparkRaat ko poora din ka hisaab
ManualBreaks solve karne ke liyeOps teamPermanent breaks ki investigation

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Reconciliation ko “optional” samajhna — bina iske paise kahan atak rahe hain ye pata hi nahi chalega. Har payment system me zaroori hai.
2. Normalization skip karna — formats alag hon to har record mismatch dikhega. Pehle data ko ek format me lao.
3. Har break ko fraud samajhna — bahut se breaks timing (cut-off) ke hote hain. Temporary vs permanent alag karo.
4. Real-time reconciliation har jagah lagana — mehenga aur complex hai. Most cases me end-of-day batch kaafi hai.
5. Double-entry bookkeeping na karna — single-entry me gadbad pakadna mushkil hai. Ledger me hamesha debit = credit rakho.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Reconciliation kya hai?””
A: Alag-alag systems ke records ko compare karke confirm karna ki amounts match karte hain. Jaise $200 ki ghadi pe website, PayPal aur ledger — teeno me $200 hona chahiye. Mismatch mile to use break kehte hain. Ye payment system ka safety net hai.
Q: ““Reconciliation ke 3 bade problems kya hain?””
A: (1) Data normalization — alag formats (dates, currencies) — fix: transformation layer. (2) Massive data volume — croreon records — fix: Flink (real-time) ya Hadoop (batch). (3) Cut-off time — din ki boundary pe records alag din me pad jate hain — fix: temporary break bolke agle din dobara match karo.
Q: ““Exactly-once hai to reconciliation kyun chahiye?””
A: Kyunki real world me bahut jagah gadbad ho sakti hai — network timeout, third-party bug, manual error, timezone issue. Exactly-once theory hai; reconciliation practical safety net hai. Bina iske tum chain se so nahi sakte — paise ka sawaal hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Website me $200 ka order hai, PayPal me $200 ka transaction hai, lekin ledger me sirf $199 credit hai. Ye kya hai?

  • ✓ Break — mismatch hai, investigation chahiye — sahi jawab
  • Normal hai — $1 ignore karo
  • Temporary break — apne aap theek ho jayega

2. Ek record internal system me 23:59:55 pe aur PayPal me 00:00:30 pe stamp hua (agle din). Sahi handling kya hai?

  • ✓ Temporary break — agle din ke records se dobara match karo — sahi jawab
  • Turant fraud report karo
  • Record ko delete kar do
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Reconciliation = shaam ko hisaab milana. Website, gateway aur ledger — teeno me amount barabar honi chahiye. Normalization, big data tools aur temporary breaks — ye 3 cheezein yaad rakh lo.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/reconciliation-in-payment.md

09Payment and Fintech

Unified Payments Interface (UPI)

India me UPI se payment karna roz ka kaam hai — lekin peeche kya hota hai? PhonePe se paise bhejo to wo seedha bank se bank nahi jata — beech me NPCI hai, VPA hai, aur 2-factor authentication hai. Is page me UPI ka poora flow — registration, bank linking, aur direct payment — step by step. (60% digital retail transactions UPI se hote hain!)

1. UPI matlab ek hi number se har bank

Socho har bank ka alag phone number hota — paise bhejne ke liye pehle pata karo kis bank me account hai, phir uska number dhoondho. UPI matlab ek hi naam (VPA) — jaise bob@axis — jo kisi bhi bank se jud sakta hai. Tumhe sirf naam yaad rakhna hai, bank ka pata NPCI ko hai.

NPCI ek switch hai — jaise telephone exchange. Tumhare bank se dusre bank tak connection NPCI jodta hai. Neeche poora flow dekhte hain.

2. UPI ka flow — 3 phases

Bob ki kahani se samjho — registration, bank linking, phir payment.

Phase 1: Registration — VPA banao

Step 1: Bob account kholna chahta hai — phone number +91 12345678 deta hai.

Step 2: OTP verification — phone pe aaya OTP daal ke number verify karta hai.

Step 3: Bob apna VPA (Virtual Payment Address) banata hai — jaise bob@axis. VPA ek simple naam hai — bank account number yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.

Step 4–6: Payment app VPA banane ke liye acquiring bank ko request bhejti hai → bank VPA return karta hai → app Bob ko VPA deti hai.

VPA yaad rakh lo: ye tumhari UPI pehchan hai — jaise email ID. Paise bhejne ke liye sirf VPA chahiye, account number nahi.

Phase 2: Bank account link karo

Bob apna SBI bank account VPA bob@axis se link karna chahta hai. Request NPCI ko jati hai.

NPCI kya karta hai: NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) ek switch hai — acquiring banks aur issuing banks ke beech. Wo VPA se account details resolve karta hai — alag-alag banks se poochh ke.

Bob apne account details se authenticate karta hai aur PIN set karta hai — ye 2FA (two-factor authentication) hai — PIN issuing bank tak jata hai. PIN ke bina koi payment nahi ho sakta — yehi UPI ki security hai.

Phase 3: Direct payment — Alice Bob ko ₹100 bhejti hai

Step 1: Alice Bob ki UPI ID (bob@axis) aur amount ₹100 daalti hai.

Step 2: PhonePe request ko ICICI bank ke through NPCI ko forward karta hai.

Step 3: NPCI Axis Bank se Bob ki details resolve karta hai.

Step 4: NPCI Alice ke HDFC account se ₹100 deduct karta hai.

Step 5: NPCI SBI bank ko instruction bhejta hai — Bob ke account me ₹100 add karo.

Step 6: Success hone pe NPCI dono payment apps ko (acquiring banks ke through) notify karta hai. Paise seconds me pahunch jate hain — real-time!

UPI itna successful kyun hai?

1. Interoperable: koi bhi app, koi bhi bank — sab ek standard pe. PhonePe se Google Pay ko bhej sakte ho.

2. Free aur instant: paise seconds me, aksar bina fee ke.

3. Simple: sirf VPA ya QR chahiye — account number, IFSC yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.

4. Secure: har payment pe UPI PIN (2FA) — phone chori ho bhi jaye to PIN ke bina paise nahi nikalte.

Scale: UPI India ke 60% digital retail transactions handle karta hai — duniya ke liye ek case study hai.

3. UPI ke players — kaun kya karta hai

PlayerKaamExample
UserPayment karta hai / leta haiAlice, Bob
Payment AppInterface — VPA, QR, PINPhonePe, GPay, Paytm
Acquiring BankApp ki taraf se NPCI se baat karta haiICICI, Axis
NPCISwitch — banks ke beech routing + settlementNPCI (central)
Issuing BankAccount jahan paise hainHDFC, SBI
VPATumhari UPI pehchanbob@axis
UPI PIN2FA — har payment pe4/6 digit PIN
// UPI payment ka flow — ek line me
Alice (PhonePe) -> ICICI (acquiring) -> NPCI (switch)
  -> NPCI: Alice ke HDFC se ₹100 deduct karo
  -> NPCI: SBI ko bolo Bob ke account me ₹100 add karo
  -> NPCI: dono apps ko success notify karo
// Total time: seconds. Fee: aksar zero.
// UPI = payment markup language + interoperable payments ka standard

4. Try karo — UPI payment simulator

4. Try karo — UPI payment simulator

Alice se Bob ko ₹100 bhejo — dekho paise NPCI se hote hue kaise pahunchte hain. Phir galat PIN daal ke dekho kya hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • Payment: Alice -> Bob, ₹100
  • Galat UPI PIN daalo
  • Collect request: Bob Alice se maange

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- UPI Simulator ---

[Payment] Alice ne bob@axis ko ₹100 bheje (PhonePe)

  • Step 1: PhonePe -> ICICI bank -> NPCI
  • Step 2: NPCI ne Axis se Bob ki details resolve ki
  • Step 3: Alice ke HDFC se ₹100 deduct hue
  • Step 4: SBI ko instruction — Bob ke account me ₹100 add hue
  • Step 5: Dono apps ko success notification. Time: 3 second!

[Galat PIN] Alice ne galat UPI PIN daala.

  • NPCI ne payment reject kiya — paise kahin nahi gaye.
  • 3 baar galat PIN = account temporarily block. Yehi 2FA ki taakat hai — phone milne se paise nahi milte.

[Collect Request] Bob ne Alice se ₹100 maange (collect request).

  • Alice ke app pe notification aaya — usne PIN daal ke approve kiya.
  • Phir wahi flow: HDFC se deduct -> SBI me add. Collect me bhi PIN dene wala hi approve karta hai.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: UPI ka jaadu VPA + NPCI switch + UPI PIN hai — simple, instant aur secure.

5. UPI vs purane tareeke

CheezNEFT/IMPS (purana)UPI
Details chahiyeAccount no + IFSCSirf VPA / QR / phone no
TimeNEFT: ghante; IMPS: minutesSeconds
FeeLagti haiAksar zero
InteroperableBank to bankApp to app, bank to bank — sab
AuthenticationNetbanking loginUPI PIN (2FA)
24×7NEFT: nahi (pehle)Haan, hamesha

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. UPI PIN kisi ko batana — bank kabhi PIN nahi mangta. Jo PIN mange wo fraud hai. PIN sirf tumhare app me daalo.
2. Collect request blindly approve karna — fraud log collect request bhej ke paise mangte hain. Approve karne se pehle amount aur naam check karo.
3. QR scan karke “paise lene” ke liye PIN daalna — paise lene ke liye PIN nahi lagta, sirf bhejne ke liye. QR + PIN = tum paise bhej rahe ho, le nahi rahe!
4. VPA ko account number samajhna — VPA sirf ek naam hai. Asli account peeche linked hai — VPA badal sakta hai, account nahi.
5. UPI PIN kisi se share karna — PIN sirf tumhara hai; bank ya koi bhi kabhi PIN nahi maangta. Collect request aaye to amount aur sender ko dhyaan se dekho — paise bhejne ke liye PIN nahi, lene ke liye hota hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““UPI kaise kaam karta hai?””
A: UPI me har user ka ek VPA (Virtual Payment Address) hota hai — jaise bob@axis. Payment app request ko acquiring bank ke through NPCI ko bhejti hai. NPCI ek switch hai — wo VPA se account resolve karta hai, payer ke bank se paise deduct karwata hai, payee ke bank me add karwata hai, aur dono apps ko notify karta hai. Har payment pe UPI PIN (2FA) lagta hai. Paise seconds me pahunchte hain.
Q: ““NPCI kya hai?””
A: National Payments Corporation of India — UPI ka central switch. Ye acquiring banks aur issuing banks ke beech baith ke payments route karta hai aur settle karta hai. Iske bina har app ko har bank se alag connection karna padta — NPCI ek standard banata hai jisse koi bhi app kisi bhi bank ko pay kar sakti hai.
Q: ““UPI itna successful kyun hai?””
A: Teen wajahen: interoperability — koi bhi app, koi bhi bank; simplicity — sirf VPA/QR chahiye, account number nahi; aur cost + speed — seconds me, aksar free. Plus UPI PIN se security. Isi liye UPI India ke 60% digital retail transactions handle karta hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Alice PhonePe se Bob (bob@axis, SBI account) ko ₹100 bhejti hai. Beech me kaun switch ka kaam karta hai?

  • ✓ NPCI — wo VPA resolve karta hai aur banks ke beech routing karta hai — sahi jawab
  • PhonePe khud seedha SBI ko paise bhejta hai
  • RBI seedha transfer karta hai

2. Koi tumhe QR bhej ke kehta hai “scan karo aur PIN daalo, paise mil jayenge”. Sahi kya hai?

  • ✓ FRAUD — paise lene ke liye PIN nahi lagta; PIN daaloge to paise TUM bhej doge — sahi jawab
  • Sahi hai — PIN daalne se paise milte hain
  • QR scan karna hi kaafi hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: UPI = VPA (ek naam) + NPCI (switch) + UPI PIN (2FA). Paise seconds me, kisi bhi app se kisi bhi bank ko. Aur yaad rakh lo — paise lene ke liye PIN kabhi nahi lagta.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/unified-payments-interface-upi-in-india.md
