10Payment and Fintech

How Scan to Pay Works

Dukaan pe QR scan karke pay karte ho — 1 second me ho jata hai. Lekin peeche do sub-processes chalte hain: pehle merchant QR banata hai (7 steps), phir tum scan karke pay karte ho (5 steps). Is page me Scan to Pay ka poora flow — PSP, payment gateway aur QR code URL ke saath.

1. Scan to Pay matlab pehle token lo, phir paise do

Socho tum ek function me ja rahe ho. Pehle gate pe token milta hai (QR code banna) — token pe tumhara table number aur bill likha hai. Phir tum token dikha ke payment counter pe paise dete ho (scan + pay). Token banane aur paise dene ka kaam alag-alag log karte hain — lekin token hi dono ko jodta hai.

Scan to Pay me QR code hi wo token hai — usme order ID aur amount chhupa hai. Neeche dono halves dekhte hain.

2. Do halves — QR banna aur payment hona

Har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Part 1: Merchant QR kaise banata hai (7 steps, 1 second se kam)

Step 1: Cashier saaman total karta hai — jaise $123.45, order ID SN129803 — aur “checkout” dabata hai.

Step 2: Cashier ka computer order ID aur amount PSP (Payment Service Provider) ko bhejta hai.

Step 3: PSP info ko database me save karta hai aur ek QR code URL generate karta hai.

Step 4: PSP ka Payment Gateway service QR code URL padhta hai.

Step 5: Payment gateway QR code URL merchant ke computer ko wapas bhejta hai.

Step 6: Merchant ka computer QR code URL (ya image) checkout counter ko bhejta hai.

Step 7: Checkout counter QR code dikhata hai. Ye saare 7 steps 1 second se kam me ho jate hain.

Part 2: Consumer scan karke pay karta hai (5 steps)

Step 1: Consumer apna digital wallet app (PayPal, Paytm, Venmo) khol ke QR scan karta hai.

Step 2: Amount sahi hai ye confirm karke “Pay” dabata hai.

Step 3: Wallet app PSP ko batata hai — “consumer ne is QR ka payment kar diya”.

Step 4: PSP payment gateway is QR ko paid mark karta hai aur consumer ke wallet app ko success message bhejta hai.

Step 5: PSP payment gateway merchant ko notify karta hai — “consumer ne is QR ka payment kar diya”. Merchant saaman de deta hai.

PSP kya hai — beech wala kaun?

PSP (Payment Service Provider) wo company hai jo merchant ke liye payments handle karti hai — jaise Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal. Merchant ko har bank se alag connection nahi karna padta — PSP ek hi integration se saare payment methods de deta hai.

PSP ke andar: database (order + QR info), QR generation, aur Payment Gateway service — jo QR ko paid mark karta hai aur dono taraf notifications bhejta hai.

Payment Gateway vs PSP: gateway PSP ka ek service hai — jo payment ko authorize aur confirm karta hai. PSP poori company hai — gateway uska ek hissa.

3. Poora flow ek table me

StepKaunKya hota hai
1CashierTotal $123.45, Order SN129803, Checkout dabao
2Merchant computer → PSPOrder ID + amount bhejo
3PSPDB me save karo, QR code URL banao
4–5Payment GatewayQR URL padho, merchant ko wapas bhejo
6–7CounterQR display karo (< 1 second total)
8ConsumerWallet app se QR scan karo
9ConsumerAmount check karo, Pay dabao
10Wallet → PSPPayment done ki khabar do
11Payment GatewayQR ko paid mark karo, consumer ko success bhejo
12Payment GatewayMerchant ko notify karo — saaman do
// QR code URL me kya hota hai?
https://pay.psp.com/qr/SN129803?amt=123.45
// Ye URL ek unique payment ko point karta hai.
// Scan karne pe wallet app is URL ko kholta hai,
// PSP se order details (amount, merchant) laata hai,
// aur tum confirm karke pay karte ho.
// QR image khud sirf is URL ka encoded form hai.

Security note: QR URL guessable nahi hona chahiye — random token use karo. Warna koi aur tumhare order ka QR bana ke paise le sakta hai. Aur QR ek baar paid mark ho jaye to dobara pay nahi hona chahiye (idempotency).

4. Try karo — Scan to Pay simulator

4. Try karo — Scan to Pay simulator

Checkout se leke payment confirm hone tak ka flow chalao — aur ek fraud scenario bhi dekho.

Scenarios:

  • Normal: $123.45 ka checkout
  • Galat amount dikh rahi hai
  • QR dobara scan (double pay?)

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Scan to Pay Simulator ---

[Checkout] Cashier: total $123.45, Order SN129803

  • PSP: DB me save kiya, QR URL banaya — 0.3 second me counter pe QR dikh gaya.

[Payment] Tumne scan kiya — amount $123.45 sahi hai — Pay dabaya.

  • PSP gateway: QR ko PAID mark kiya -> tumhe success mila -> merchant ko notify hua.
  • Merchant ne saaman de diya. Total time: ~4 second.

[Galat Amount] QR scan kiya — amount $1,234.50 dikh rahi hai (tumhara bill $123.45 tha)!

  • Tumne Pay NAHI dabaya — cashier ko bataya. QR dobara banaya gaya, sahi amount ke saath.
  • Lesson: Pay dabane se pehle amount HAMESHA check karo — QR me jo hai wahi katega.

[Double Scan] Tumne paid QR ko dobara scan kiya.

  • PSP gateway: ye QR pehle se PAID mark hai — dobara payment nahi hogi.
  • "Already paid" message aaya. Idempotency ne double charge rok diya.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: QR sirf ek URL hai — asli kaam PSP karta hai: order save karna, paid mark karna, aur dono ko notify karna.

5. Scan to Pay ke players

PlayerKaam
Merchant / CashierCheckout, QR display, saaman dena
PSPOrder save karna, QR URL banana
Payment GatewayQR paid mark karna, notifications
Consumer + Wallet AppScan karna, amount check karna, pay karna
QR CodeOrder ID + amount ka encoded URL

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Amount check kiye bina Pay dabana — QR me jo amount hai wahi kategi. Hamesha pehle amount verify karo.
2. QR URL ko guessable banana — sequential order IDs (SN129803, SN129804…) se koi dusre ka QR bana sakta hai. Random token use karo.
3. Paid QR ko dobara pay karne dena — idempotency nahi hai to double charge hoga. Paid QR pe dobara payment block karo.
4. Merchant ko notify karna bhoolna — consumer ko success mil gaya lekin merchant ko pata nahi chala to saaman nahi milega. Notification zaroori hai.
5. Merchant ka naam aur amount verify kiye bina pay karna — QR pe dikh raha naam aur amount hamesha check karo; ek galat digit se paise galat account me chale jayenge.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Scan to Pay ka flow kya hai?””
A: Do halves hain. Pehla: cashier checkout dabata hai → merchant computer order ID + amount PSP ko bhejta hai → PSP DB me save karke QR code URL banata hai → payment gateway URL wapas bhejta hai → counter pe QR dikhta hai (1 second se kam). Dusra: consumer wallet se scan karta hai → amount check karke Pay dabata hai → PSP QR ko paid mark karta hai → consumer aur merchant dono ko notify karta hai.
Q: ““QR code me kya hota hai?””
A: QR code ek URL ka encoded form hai — us URL me order ID aur amount hoti hai. Wallet app URL khol ke PSP se order details laata hai. QR khud paise nahi rakhta — wo sirf ek payment ko point karta hai.
Q: ““Double payment kaise rokte ho?””
A: Idempotency se — QR ek baar paid mark ho jaye to dobara payment block hoti hai. PSP QR ki state check karta hai (unpaid → paid), aur paid QR pe “already paid” return karta hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. QR scan kiya — amount galat dikh rahi hai. Kya karna chahiye?

  • ✓ Pay mat dabao — cashier ko batao aur sahi QR banwao — sahi jawab
  • Pay kar do, refund baad me le lena
  • QR ko dobara scan karo

2. Paid QR ko dobara scan karne pe kya hona chahiye?

  • ✓ “Already paid” — dobara payment block honi chahiye (idempotency) — sahi jawab
  • Dobara paise kat jaane chahiye
  • Naya QR ban jana chahiye
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Scan to Pay = QR banao (PSP, 7 steps, 1 second) + scan karke pay karo (5 steps). QR sirf ek URL hai — asli kaam PSP karta hai. Amount check karo, aur paid QR dobara pay nahi hona chahiye.

← PichhlaUnified Payments Interface (UPI)Agla →Money Movement
11Payment and Fintech

Money Movement

Bob PayPal se Amazon pe kitab khareedta hai — paise Bob ke account se kat-te hain, Amazon ko milte hain, aur seller Claire ko bhi milte hain. Lekin asli paise kab hilte hain? Turant nahi — pehle information flow hota hai, phir fund flow. Is page me money movement ke 3 layers: Transaction, Payment & Clearing, aur Settlement — aur clearing vs settlement ka fark.

1. Money movement matlab pehle kagaz, phir cash

Socho tumhare mohalle me 3 dukaanen hain. Din bhar log udhaar lete-dete hain — kagaz pe hisaab likha jata hai (information flow): “A ne B ko ₹100 dene hain, B ne A ko ₹500 dene hain”. Shaam ko sab hisaab mila ke sirf farq ka cash diya jata hai — B, A ko ₹400 deta hai, baaki hisaab kat gaya (clearing). Cash tab hilta hai jab settlement bank me reserves se transfer hota hai (fund flow).

Yehi payment system me hota hai — information flow (kagaz) aur fund flow (cash) alag hain, aur fund flow hamesha baad me, net amount pe hota hai.

2. Teen layers — ek-ek karke

Bob Amazon se Claire ki kitab khareedta hai (PayPal se). Har tab ek layer hai.

Layer 1: Transaction Layer — khareed hoti hai

Bob Amazon pe kitab khareedta hai PayPal se. Amazon PayPal ko money transfer request bhejta hai. Bob ka debit card token PayPal pe stored hai — isliye PayPal Bob ki taraf se paise Amazon ke bank account (Bank A) me transfer kar sakta hai.

Ye layer sirf “kya hua” batati hai — kaunne kya khareeda, kitne me. Yahan koi asli paise nahi hilte — sirf instructions banti hain.

Layer 2: Payment & Clearing Layer — hisaab milana

Bank A aur Bank B dono apne transaction statements clearing institution ko bhejte hain. Clearing institution hisaab milata hai aur netting karta hai — jaise Bank A ko Bank B se $100 milne hain, aur Bank B ko Bank A se $500 — to net sirf $400 Bank B se Bank A ko jaane hain.

Netting ka fayda: 1000 transactions ki jagah sirf 1 net transfer — kam paise hilte hain, kam risk, kam cost.

Pay-in flow: Bob → Amazon (PayPal ke through). Pay-out flow: Amazon → Claire (seller) — Amazon seller ko batata hai paise aayenge, phir Bank A se Bank C ko transfer request bhejta hai (pehle sirf record, paise nahi hilte).

Layer 3: Settlement Layer — asli paise hilte hain

Clearing institution clearing aur settlement info settlement bank ko bhejta hai. Bank A aur Bank B dono ne settlement bank me reserves (pehle se jama paise) rakhe hote hain. Asli paise in reserve accounts ke beech hilte hain — Bank B ke reserve se Bank A ke reserve me $400.

Yehi asli money movement hai. Pehle do layers me sirf information thi — yahan fund flow hai.

Timing: settlement aksar end-of-day hota hai — din bhar ke saare transactions ka net ek saath settle hota hai.

Information Flow vs Fund Flow — sabse important fark

Information flow (pehli 2 layers): paise “kat-te aur judte” dikhte hain — Bob ke account se gaya, Amazon ke account me aaya. Lekin ye sirf records hain.

Fund flow (settlement layer): asli paise settlement bank ke reserves me hilte hain — asynchronous hai, din ke end me, net amount pe.

Kyun matter karta hai: dono flows alag time pe hote hain — isliye reconciliation bahut zaroori hai. Agar info flow aur fund flow match na karein to paise kahin atak gaye — aur yehi reconciliation pakadta hai (Page 179).

Foreign exchange bonus: Bob USD me pay kare aur seller ko INR chahiye to beech me currency conversion bhi hota hai — aur bhi layers jud jati hain.

3. Pay-in aur Pay-out — dono flows

StepPay-in (Bob → Amazon)Pay-out (Amazon → Claire)
1Bob kitab khareedta hai (PayPal)Amazon Claire ko batata hai paise aayenge
2Amazon → PayPal: transfer requestAmazon: Bank A → Bank C transfer request
3PayPal: Bob ki taraf se Bank A ko paiseDono banks records banate hain (paise nahi hilte)
4Bank A aur B statements clearing ko bhejte hainBank A aur C statements clearing ko bhejte hain
5Netting: B, A ko $400 dega (net)Netting ke baad settlement info bank ko
6Settlement bank: reserves me $400 transferSettlement bank: Bank A ke reserve se Bank C ke reserve me transfer
// Netting ka example — kyun net karte hain?
// Din bhar ke transactions:
//   Bank A owes Bank B: $100
//   Bank B owes Bank A: $500
// Bina netting: 2 transfers ($100 + $500 = $600 hilte hain)
// Netting ke saath: 1 transfer ($400, B -> A)
// Paise kam hilte hain = kam risk + kam cost + kam liquidity chahiye.
// Isi liye banks ko settlement bank me kam reserves rakhne padte hain.

4. Try karo — money movement simulator

4. Try karo — money movement simulator

Bob ki kitab ki khareed chalao — dekho information flow aur fund flow alag-alag kaise chalte hain.

Scenarios:

  • Pay-in: Bob -> Amazon ($100)
  • Pay-out: Amazon -> Claire ($100)
  • FX: Bob USD deta hai, Claire INR leti hai

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Money Movement Simulator: Bob buys a book ($100) ---

[Pay-in] Bob ne PayPal se $100 pay kiye.

  • Info flow: Amazon -> PayPal request -> PayPal ne Bank A ko $100 bheje (record).
  • Clearing: Bank A ($100 Bank B se) aur Bank B ($500 Bank A se) — net: Bank B, Bank A ko $400 dega.
  • Fund flow (end-of-day): Settlement bank me Bank B ke reserve se Bank A ke reserve me $400 transfer.

[Pay-out] Amazon ne Claire (seller) ko $100 dene hain.

  • Info flow: Amazon -> Bank A se Bank C ko transfer request (sirf record).
  • Clearing: Bank A aur C ke statements mile, netting hui.
  • Fund flow: Settlement bank me Bank A ke reserve se Bank C ke reserve me $100 transfer.

[FX] Bob USD me pay karta hai, Claire ko INR chahiye!

  • Beech me currency conversion hota hai (Page 186) — USD -> INR, exchange rate + fee ke saath.
  • Info flow aur fund flow dono me ek aur layer jud jati hai — FX provider.
  • Koi flow nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Jo paise tum “bhejte” ho wo turant nahi hilte — pehle kagaz (info flow), phir netting, phir shaam ko asli cash (fund flow).

5. Teen layers — ek table me

LayerKya hota haiFlow typeKab
TransactionKhareed, order, payment requestInformationTurant
Payment & ClearingStatements, nettingInformationDin bhar / end-of-day
SettlementReserves ke beech transferFund (asli paise)End-of-day

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Information flow ko fund flow samajhna — account me entry dikhna matlab paise pahunch gaye nahi hota. Settlement baad me hota hai.
2. Netting ignore karna — bina netting ke har transaction alag settle karna bahut mehenga aur risky hota hai.
3. Reconciliation na karna — info flow aur fund flow async hain, isliye mismatch hote hain. Roz reconciliation zaroori hai.
4. Settlement timing bhoolna — weekend ya holiday pe settlement ruk jata hai. Seller ko paise Monday ko milenge — ye pehle se batana chahiye.
5. Authorization aur settlement ko ek samajhna — authorization sirf paise hold karta hai, asli movement settlement me hota hai (aksar din ke end me batch me). Beech me paise kahin nahi gaye hote.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Clearing aur settlement me kya farak hai?””
A: Clearing hisaab milana hai — kaun kisko kitna dega, netting ke saath. Settlement asli paise hilana hai — settlement bank ke reserve accounts ke beech transfer. Clearing information flow hai, settlement fund flow hai. Clearing pehle hoti hai, settlement baad me.
Q: ““Information flow aur fund flow alag kyun hain?””
A: Kyunki har transaction pe asli paise hilana mehenga aur slow hai. Pehle saare transactions ke records banate hain (info flow), phir unhe net karke sirf farq ka ek transfer karte hain (fund flow). Isse kam paise hilte hain, kam liquidity chahiye, aur risk kam hota hai.
Q: ““Netting kya hai?””
A: Mutual transactions ko offset karke sirf net amount settle karna. Bank A ko Bank B se $100 aur Bank B ko Bank A se $500 milne hain to net sirf $400 Bank B se Bank A ko jayenge. Bina netting ke $600 hilte — netting se sirf $400.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Bob ne $100 pay kiye aur Amazon ke account me $100 dikh bhi gaye. Asli paise kab hile?

  • ✓ End-of-day settlement me — settlement bank ke reserves ke beech, netting ke baad — sahi jawab
  • Turant — entry dikhte hi paise hil gaye
  • Kabhi nahi — sirf entries hoti hain

2. Bank A ko Bank B se $100 aur Bank B ko Bank A se $500 milne hain. Netting ke baad kitna transfer hoga?

  • ✓ Sirf $400, Bank B se Bank A ko — sahi jawab
  • $600 — dono alag-alag
  • $100 — chhota wala hi
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Paise 3 layers se hilte hain: Transaction (kya hua), Clearing (hisaab + netting), Settlement (asli cash, reserves me, end-of-day). Entry dikhna settlement nahi hai — isliye reconciliation zaroori hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/money-movement.md
← PichhlaHow Scan to Pay WorksAgla →Payment System
12Payment and Fintech

Payment System

Amazon pe “Buy” dabate hi peeche kya hota hai? Ek payment event banta hai, payment service use save karti hai, payment executor PSP se paise leta hai, wallet seller ka balance update karta hai, aur ledger hisaab likhta hai. Is page me payment system ka poora flow — event se settlement file tak.

1. Payment system matlab ek factory ki assembly line

Socho ek factory hai. Payment service reception hai — order aate hi entry karta hai. Payment executor worker hai — jo actual kaam karta hai (PSP se paise lena). Wallet cashier hai — seller ke paise ka hisaab rakhta hai. Ledger accountant hai — har cheez ka pakka record rakhta hai. Har station ka kaam alag hai — ek ruke to line ruk jati hai, lekin har station alag system hai taaki scale kar sake.

2. Payment flow — step by step

User “Buy” dabata hai — yahan se shuru hota hai.

Step 1–2: Payment event banta hai

User “Buy” dabata hai → ek payment event generate hota hai aur payment service ko bheja jata hai. Payment service event ko database me store karti hai — taaki kuch bhi fail ho to event dobara process ho sake (reliability ke liye).

Kyun store karte hain: agar PSP call fail ho jaye to event dobara retry kar sakte hain — bina event store kiye payment kho jayega.

Step 3–5: Payment executor paise leta hai

Ek payment event me multiple payment orders ho sakte hain — jaise ek checkout me 3 sellers ke products hon to 3 alag orders. Payment service har payment order ke liye payment executor ko call karti hai.

Payment executor order ko DB me store karta hai, phir external PSP (jaise Stripe, Razorpay) ko call karke credit card payment complete karta hai. PSP hi asli paise card se leta hai.

Step 6–7: Wallet update hota hai

Payment executor ke success ke baad, payment service wallet ko call karti hai — seller ka balance update karne ke liye. Wallet server updated balance ko DB me store karta hai.

Wallet kya hai: har seller ka “khata” — kitne paise mile, kitne nikale. Seller apna balance wallet me dekhta hai aur payout le sakta hai.

Step 8–9: Ledger me entry

Wallet update ke baad payment service ledger ko call karti hai. Ledger service nayi ledger information ko DB me append karti hai — double-entry bookkeeping (debit buyer, credit seller).

Ledger append-only hai — purani entries kabhi update/delete nahi hoti, sirf nayi judti hain. Isse hisaab hamesha audit kar sakte hain.

Step 10: Settlement files — raat ko hisaab

Har raat PSP ya banks settlement files bhejte hain apne clients ko. File me bank account ka balance aur din bhar ke saare transactions hote hain.

Payment system in files ko apne records se reconcile karta hai (Page 179) — koi mismatch ho to break banta hai aur investigation hoti hai.

3. Payment system ke components — ek table me

ComponentKaamDatabase me kya
Payment ServiceEvents receive karna, orchestrate karnaPayment events
Payment ExecutorPSP se payment karwanaPayment orders
PSP (external)Card/bank se paise lena— (bahar ka system)
Wallet ServiceSeller balance track karnaWallet balances
Ledger ServiceDouble-entry hisaabLedger entries (append-only)
// Payment flow — pseudo-code
on BuyButtonClick():
  event = { user_id, items: [...], total: 4999 }
  paymentService.store(event)              // Step 2: event DB me

  for each seller_order in event.splitBySeller():  // Step 3: ek event, kai orders
    executor.execute(seller_order)         // Step 4: order DB me
    psp.charge(card, seller_order.amount)  // Step 5: PSP se paise lo

  wallet.credit(seller_id, amount)         // Step 6-7: seller ka balance
  ledger.append(debit=buyer, credit=seller) // Step 8-9: hisaab likho
// Raat ko: settlement file aayegi -> reconcile karo (Step 10)

Idempotency yaad rakh lo: har payment order ka ek unique ID hota hai — PSP call retry ho to bhi double charge nahi hota (Page 187).

4. Try karo — payment system simulator

4. Try karo — payment system simulator

Ek checkout chalao — dekho payment event kaise 3 sellers ke orders me bat-ta hai aur har component kya karta hai.

Scenarios:

  • Single seller: 1 product, ₹999
  • Multi seller: 3 sellers, ₹4,999
  • PSP fail: card decline

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Payment System Simulator ---

[Single Seller] Buy dabaya — payment event bana, DB me store hua.

  • Executor: 1 payment order -> PSP se ₹999 charge success.
  • Wallet: seller ka balance +₹999. Ledger: debit buyer ₹999, credit seller ₹999.
  • Raat ko settlement file aayegi — reconcile hoga. Payment poora!

[Multi Seller] Checkout me 3 sellers ke products — ₹4,999 total.

  • Payment service ne event ko 3 payment orders me baanta:
  • Order 1: Seller A — ₹1,999 | Order 2: Seller B — ₹2,000 | Order 3: Seller C — ₹1,000
  • Executor ne har order ke liye alag PSP call ki. Wallet: 3 sellers ke balances update hue.
  • Ledger: 3 entries append hui. Ek event, 3 orders, 3 wallets — sab alag track hote hain.

[PSP Fail] PSP ne card decline kiya (insufficient funds).

  • Executor: order ko FAILED mark kiya. Wallet aur Ledger ko call hi nahi hui — paise kahi nahi gaye.
  • Payment service: event ko retry queue me dala? Nahi — card decline retry karne se fayda nahi.
  • User ko bataya gaya: payment fail, dobara try karo. Event DB me hai — audit ke liye.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Payment system ek assembly line hai — event, executor, PSP, wallet, ledger — har station alag, aur har step DB me record hota hai.

5. Payment system design ke principles

PrincipleKaise
ReliabilityEvents DB me store karo — fail ho to retry karo
IdempotencyHar order ka unique ID — double charge nahi
AuditabilityLedger append-only — purana hisaab kabhi mat badlo
SeparationWallet aur ledger alag — ek balance, ek hisaab
ReconciliationRaat ko settlement files se milao

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Payment event ko DB me store kiye bina process karna — crash ho to payment kho jayega. Pehle store karo, phir process karo.
2. Wallet aur ledger ko ek hi samajhna — wallet balance hai (kitna hai), ledger history hai (kya hua). Dono alag systems hain.
3. Ledger entries ko update/delete karna — ledger append-only hota hai. Galti ho to nayi correcting entry daalo, purani mat badlo.
4. Multi-seller order ko ek payment samajhna — har seller ka alag order, alag PSP call, alag wallet update hota hai.
5. Settlement files ko reconcile na karna — PSP ke hisaab aur tumhare hisaab me fark ho to paise atak jayenge. Roz reconcile karo.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Payment system ka flow kya hai?””
A: User Buy dabata hai → payment event banta hai aur payment service use DB me store karti hai → event payment orders me bat-ta hai (har seller ka alag) → payment executor har order ke liye PSP se paise leta hai → wallet seller ka balance update karta hai → ledger me double-entry likhi jati hai → raat ko settlement files se reconcile hota hai.
Q: ““Wallet aur ledger me kya farak hai?””
A: Wallet current balance batata hai — seller ke paas abhi kitne paise hain. Ledger history batata hai — kab kya hua, kisne kisko kitna diya. Wallet ek number hai, ledger ek kitaab hai. Dono alag systems hain — wallet fast reads ke liye, ledger audit ke liye.
Q: ““Payment event ko pehle DB me kyun store karte ho?””
A: Reliability ke liye. Agar PSP call ke beech system crash ho jaye to event DB me hai — dobara process kar sakte hain. Bina store kiye payment kho jayega — user ko paise katenge ya nahi, ye pata hi nahi chalega.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Ek checkout me 3 sellers ke products hain. Payment system kya karega?

  • ✓ Event ko 3 payment orders me baant ke har ek ke liye alag PSP call karega — sahi jawab
  • Ek hi payment se 3 sellers ko paise de dega
  • Sirf pehle seller ko paise dega

2. Ledger me galat entry ho gayi. Sahi fix kya hai?

  • ✓ Nayi correcting entry append karo — purani entry kabhi update/delete mat karo — sahi jawab
  • Purani entry ko edit kar do
  • Ledger ko delete karke dobara banao
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Payment system ek assembly line hai: event store karo, orders me baanto, PSP se paise lo, wallet me balance badhao, ledger me hisaab likho, aur raat ko settlement file se milao. Ledger append-only hai — purana hisaab kabhi mat badlo.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/payment-system.md

13Payment and Fintech

How to Learn Payments

Payments seekhna hai to kahan se shuru karo? Ye page ek mindmap hai — poori payment industry ka top-down view. Regulatory authority se leke settlement systems tak — 7 bade parts, aur har part ke andar aur bhi duniya. Is page se tumhe pata chalega ki payments me kya-kya seekhna hai aur kis order me.

1. Payment industry matlab ek sheher ka map

Socho payment industry ek sheher hai. Regulatory Authority aur Central Bank sheher ki sarkar hain — rules banate hain. Commercial Banks bade buildings hain — paise rakhte hain. Non-Bank Payment Companies (Paytm, Stripe) naye startups hain — naye tareeke se kaam karte hain. Payment Systems, Clearing Networks aur Settlement Systems sheher ki sadkein, bridges aur transport hain — paise ko ek jagah se dusri jagah le jate hain.

Map samajh gaye to sheher me ghumna aasan hai — neeche har hissa dekhte hain.

2. Payment industry ke 7 parts

Har tab ek part hai — kya hai aur kyun matter karta hai.

1. Regulatory Authority — rules kaun banata hai

Payment industry heavily regulated hai — har desh me ek authority hai jo rules banati hai: kaun payment company chala sakta hai, KYC kya hoga, fraud kaise rokenge. India me RBI, US me Federal Reserve + OCC, Europe me ECB.

Kyun seekhna: payment system design karte waqt pehla sawaal hamesha compliance ka hota hai — “ye allowed hai ya nahi?” Bina iske system ban hi nahi sakta.

2. Central Bank — paise ka source

Central bank (RBI, Fed) currency issue karta hai aur settlement ka final authority hai. Banks apne reserves central bank me rakhte hain — settlement wahi hota hai.

Example: UPI ka settlement NPCI karta hai, lekin final settlement RBI ke through hota hai. Central bank hi “risk-free” paise ka source hai.

3. Commercial Banks — jahan tumhara account hai

SBI, HDFC, ICICI — ye banks hain jo tumhare paise rakhte hain, cards issue karte hain, aur payment systems se connect hote hain. Har payment ke peeche ek bank hota hai — chahe app koi bhi ho.

Issuing bank (tumhara card dene wala) aur acquiring bank (merchant ka bank) — dono alag roles hain. Payment ecosystem Page 185 me detail me hai.

4. Non-Bank Payment Companies — naye players

Paytm, PhonePe, Stripe, Square — ye bank nahi hain, lekin payment services dete hain. Inhe license lena padta hai (jaise PPI license, payment aggregator license) aur inke paise bhi kisi bank me hi hote hain.

Kyun important: innovation yahin se aata hai — UPI apps, QR payments, instant settlement — sab non-bank companies ne popular kiye.

5. Payment Systems — paise bhejne ke rails

UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT, ACH, Visa/Mastercard networks — ye sab payment systems hain, matlab paise bhejne ke alag-alag tareeke (rails). Har rail ki apni speed, cost aur limit hai.

Example: UPI instant aur free hai; RTGS bade amounts ke liye hai; SWIFT cross-border ke liye hai. Sahi rail chunna system design ka hissa hai.

6–7. Clearing Networks aur Settlement Systems

Clearing: transactions ka hisaab milana aur netting karna (kaun kisko kitna dega). Settlement: asli paise hilana — central bank ke reserves se.

Example: Visa transactions din bhar hote hain (clearing), lekin banks ke beech paise end-of-day settle hote hain. Clearing aur settlement ka fark Page 182 me detail me hai.

Seekhne ka order: pehle players (banks, NPCI, regulators), phir rails (UPI, cards), phir clearing/settlement ka flow.

3. Seekhne ka roadmap — kahan se shuru karo

4. Try karo — payment learning path

4. Try karo — payment learning path

Apna level chuno — dekho tumhe aage kya seekhna hai aur kaunsa page padhna hai.

Scenarios:

  • Main beginner hoon

  • Main payment system design kar raha hoon

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Payment Learning Path ---

[Beginner] Shuruaat yahan se karo:

  • 1. Page 182 — Money Movement (paise kaise hilte hain)
  • 2. Page 180 — UPI (roz use karte ho, andar samjho)
  • 3. Page 183 — Payment System (components)
  • 4. Page 177 — QR Payments (4 tareeke)

[Intermediate] Ab ye padho:

  • 1. Page 189 — VISA flow (authorization + settlement)
  • 2. Page 179 — Reconciliation (safety net)
  • 3. Page 187 — Double Payment (idempotency)
  • 4. Page 185 — Payments Ecosystem (saare players)

[Advanced] System design ke liye:

  • 4. Glenbrook "Payment Systems in the U.S." + BIS website — deep reading
  • Apna level nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Payments top-down seekho — pehle money movement, phir rails, phir problems. Seedha code se shuru mat karo.

5. Har desh ka framework alag hai

DeshRegulatorPopular rails
IndiaRBIUPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS
USFed, OCCACH, Fedwire, Cards
EuropeECBSEPA, Cards
Cross-border—SWIFT, Visa/Mastercard

Yaad rakh lo: har desh ka payment framework alag hai — lekin concepts ek jaise hain: clearing, settlement, reconciliation, idempotency. Concepts seekho, framework badal jayega to bhi kaam aayega.

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Seedha code se shuru karna — pehle money movement aur concepts samjho. Bina concepts ke payment code likhna dangerous hai.
2. Ek desh ka system sab jagah lagana — UPI India me hai, US me ACH hai. Har desh ka framework alag hai.
3. Compliance ko baad me sochna — payments me compliance pehle aata hai, features baad me. License, KYC, audit — ye design ka hissa hain.
4. Reconciliation aur idempotency skip karna — ye “boring” parts hain lekin payment system ki jaan hain. Inke bina system production me nahi chalega.
5. Sirf ek payment method seekhna — payments ecosystem bada hai: cards, UPI, ACH, SWIFT, wallets — har ek ka flow alag hai. Ek seekh ke baaki ko ignore mat karo.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Payments seekhne ke liye kahan se shuru karoon?””
A: Top-down: pehle money movement samjho (paise kaise hilte hain — clearing vs settlement), phir payment system components (service, executor, wallet, ledger), phir ek rail deep me (jaise UPI ya Visa), phir problems (double payment, reconciliation, hotspot). Concepts ek jaise hain — framework badal jayega to bhi kaam aayega.
Q: ““Payment industry ke main parts kaunse hain?””
A: 7 parts: Regulatory Authority (rules), Central Bank (currency + final settlement), Commercial Banks (accounts + cards), Non-Bank Payment Companies (Paytm, Stripe), Payment Systems (UPI, SWIFT, ACH — rails), Clearing Networks (hisaab milana), aur Settlement Systems (asli paise hilana).
Q: ““Har desh ka payment framework alag kyun hai?””
A: Kyunki har desh ka regulator, banking system aur history alag hai. India me UPI hai (RBI + NPCI), US me ACH hai (Fed), Europe me SEPA hai. Lekin underlying concepts — clearing, settlement, reconciliation, idempotency — sab jagah ek jaise hain.

8. Quick check

  • ✓ Top-down: pehle money movement, phir components, phir ek rail deep me — sahi jawab
  • Seedha Stripe API se shuru karo
  • Pehle saare regulations yaad karo

2. Payment industry me “rails” ka matlab kya hai?

  • ✓ Paise bhejne ke alag-alag tareeke — UPI, NEFT, SWIFT, ACH — sahi jawab
  • Train ki patri
  • Bank ki building
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Payments top-down seekho: pehle money movement, phir components, phir rails (UPI, Visa, SWIFT, ACH), phir problems (reconciliation, idempotency, hotspot). Concepts ek jaise hain — har desh ka framework alag hai.

14Payment and Fintech

The Payments Ecosystem

PayPal, Stripe, Square — ye companies karti kya hain, exactly? Koi gateway hai, koi processor, koi network. Is page me payments ecosystem ka poora map — cardholder se leke issuing bank tak, 9 steps me — aur samjhenge ki fintech startups isme opportunity kahan dhoondhte hain.

1. Payments ecosystem matlab ek relay race

Socho ek relay race hai — baton (payment) ek khiladi se dusre ko milti hai. Cardholder race shuru karta hai → Gateway baton leta hai → Processor aage badhata hai → Card Network (Visa) beech me → Issuing Processor → Issuing Bank finish karta hai. Har khiladi ka kaam alag hai — ek bhi slow ho to race slow ho jati hai.

Neeche 9 steps me poori race dekhte hain.

2. Ecosystem ke steps — 0 se 8

Har tab race ka ek hissa hai.

Steps 0–1: Setup — account kholo

Cardholder issuing bank me account kholta hai aur debit/credit card leta hai. Merchant ISO (Independent Sales Organization) ya MSP (Member Service Provider) ke through register karta hai — in-store sales ke liye. ISO/MSP payment processors ke saath partner karke merchant accounts kholta hai.

ISO/MSP kya hai: beech wale jo merchants ko payment system se jodte hain — chhote merchants seedha bank se deal nahi kar sakte, isliye ISO/MSP ke through aate hain.

Steps 2–5: Acquiring process — paise lena

Payment Gateway purchase transaction accept karta hai aur payment info collect karta hai. Phir use Payment Processor ko bhejta hai, jo customer info se payment collect karta hai.

Acquiring Processor transaction ko card network (Visa/Mastercard) ko bhejta hai. Ye merchant ka account bhi operate karta hai settlement ke time — lekin settlement real-time nahi hota, baad me hota hai.

Gateway vs Processor: gateway “darwaza” hai — transaction accept karta hai. Processor “engine” hai — transaction ko process karta hai aur network tak pahunchata hai. Dono alag companies ho sakti hain.

Steps 6–8: Issuing process — paise dena

Issuing Processor card network se baat karta hai issuing bank ki taraf se. Wo customer ka account validate karta hai aur operate karta hai — “is card pe itne paise hain? Payment approve karein?”

Issuing Bank final decision leta hai — approve ya decline. Approve hote hi paise ka flow ulta chalta hai — wapas merchant tak (settlement ke time).

Fintech startups ko opportunity kahan milti hai?

Payment companies aksar ek vertical se shuru karti hain, phir multiple verticals me expand karti hain. Jaise Stripe payments se shuru hua, phir billing, fraud detection, banking — sab karne laga. Square POS se shuru hua, phir loans aur banking me gaya.

Opportunity kahan hai: jahan process slow, mehenga ya complex hai — jaise cross-border payments, small merchant onboarding, ya fraud detection. Startup ek vertical me best bano, phir expand karo.

3. Players — kaun kya karta hai

PlayerKaamExample
CardholderCard se pay karta haiTum
MerchantSaaman bechta haiDukaan / Amazon
ISO / MSPMerchant ko onboard karta haiIndependent Sales Org
Payment GatewayTransaction accept karta haiStripe Gateway, Razorpay
Payment ProcessorTransaction process karta haiStripe, Adyen, Worldpay
Acquiring ProcessorMerchant ke bank ki taraf seAcquirer side processor
Card NetworkBanks ko jodta hai, rules banata haiVisa, Mastercard, RuPay
Issuing ProcessorCardholder ke bank ki taraf seIssuer side processor
Issuing BankCard issue karta hai, approve karta haiHDFC, SBI, Chase

Yaad rakh lo: gateway aur processor alag hain, acquiring aur issuing alag hain. Interview me ye farak poochte hain.

4. Try karo — payment relay race

4. Try karo — payment relay race

Ek card payment chalao — dekho baton (payment) kaise ek player se dusre tak pahunchti hai.

Scenarios:

  • Race chalao: ₹2,000 ka card payment
  • Card decline: balance kam hai

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Payments Ecosystem Relay Race: ₹2,000 ---

  • Step 0-1: Cardholder (tum) + Merchant (dukaan) — dono ke accounts ready hain.
  • Step 2: Payment Gateway ne transaction accept kiya (card details collect ki).
  • Step 3-4: Payment Processor -> Acquiring Processor -> Card Network (Visa).
  • Step 5: Visa ne transaction Issuing Processor ko bheja.
  • Step 6-8: Issuing Processor -> Issuing Bank (HDFC) — balance check OK -> APPROVED!
  • Approval wapas aaya: Visa -> Acquirer -> Gateway -> Merchant. "Payment successful"!
  • Settlement: baad me hoga (end-of-day) — paise tab hilenge. Abhi sirf approval mila hai.

[DECLINE] Issuing Bank ne check kiya — balance ₹1,200 hai, payment ₹2,000 ka hai.

  • Issuing Bank: DECLINED. Ye decision wapas aaya: Visa -> Acquirer -> Gateway -> Merchant.
  • "Payment failed — insufficient funds" — paise kahin nahi gaye.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Payment ek relay race hai — har player ka kaam alag hai, aur approval milna settlement nahi hai.

5. Companies kahan baithti hain

VerticalCompanies
GatewayStripe, Razorpay, Authorize.net
ProcessorStripe, Adyen, Worldpay, Fiserv
Card NetworkVisa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex
Wallet / AppPayPal, PhonePe, Google Pay
POS / MerchantSquare, Pine Labs

Pattern: companies ek vertical se shuru hoti hain aur phir expand karti hain — Stripe gateway se processor bana, phir banking tak gaya. Ek vertical me best bano, phir aage badho.

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Gateway aur processor ko ek samajhna — gateway transaction accept karta hai, processor use process karta hai. Alag roles, alag companies ho sakti hain.
2. Approval ko settlement samajhna — approval ka matlab “paise milenge”, settlement ka matlab “paise mil gaye”. Dono ke beech ghante/din lagte hain.
3. Acquiring aur issuing confuse karna — acquiring merchant ke bank ki taraf, issuing cardholder ke bank ki taraf. Dono alag hain.
4. Card network ko bank samajhna — Visa paise nahi rakhta, wo banks ko jodta hai aur rules banata hai. Paise banks ke paas hote hain.
5. Interchange fee ko bhoolna — har card transaction me kai parties (issuer, acquirer, network) ko fee milti hai. Ye fee hi poora ecosystem chalati hai — bina ise samjhe payments design nahi kar sakte.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Payment gateway aur payment processor me kya farak hai?””
A: Gateway transaction accept karta hai — merchant ki site/app pe card details collect karta hai aur securely processor ko bhejta hai. Processor transaction ko process karta hai — use acquiring bank aur card network tak pahunchata hai. Gateway darwaza hai, processor engine hai.
Q: ““Acquiring aur issuing bank me kya farak hai?””
A: Issuing bank cardholder ka bank hai — jo card issue karta hai aur payment approve/decline karta hai. Acquiring bank merchant ka bank hai — jo merchant ki taraf se paise receive karta hai. Ek transaction me dono lagte hain — aur card network (Visa) inhe jodta hai.
Q: ““Payment companies ek vertical se kyun shuru hoti hain?””
A: Kyunki payments complex aur regulated hai — ek cheez me best banna hi mushkil hai. Stripe payments se shuru hua, Square POS se. Ek vertical me trust aur scale banao, phir adjacent verticals me expand karo — billing, fraud, loans, banking.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Tumne card se pay kiya aur “approved” aaya. Kya paise merchant ko mil gaye?

  • ✓ Nahi — approval mila hai, settlement baad me hoga (end-of-day) — sahi jawab
  • Haan — approve hote hi paise mil jate hain
  • Paise card network ke paas hain

2. Payment gateway ka kaam kya hai?

  • ✓ Transaction accept karna aur card details securely processor ko bhejna — sahi jawab
  • Paise apne paas rakhna
  • Card issue karna
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Payments ek relay race hai: Gateway → Processor → Acquirer → Card Network → Issuing Processor → Issuing Bank. Approval milna settlement nahi hai — paise baad me hilte hain. Companies ek vertical se shuru hoti hain, phir expand karti hain.

15Payment and Fintech

Foreign Exchange Payments

Bob America se Alice (Europe) ko $100 bhejta hai — lekin Alice ko euros chahiye. Dollar euro me kaise badalta hai? Foreign exchange (forex) se — aur iske peeche 3 layers ka market hai: Retail, Wholesale aur Top-level participants. Is page me $100 ka safar — PayPal se Bank E ke funding pool se leke wholesale market tak.

1. Forex matlab paise ki mandi — 3 floors

Socho ek 3-floor ki mandi hai. Ground floor (Retail): chhoti dukaanen — PayPal jaise log yahan se currency khareedte hain, thoda-thoda. First floor (Wholesale): bade vyapari (investment banks) — jab ground floor ka stock khatam ho to yahan se lete hain. Top floor: sabse bade players (multinational banks) — jinke paas duniya bhar ki currency ka bhandar hai.

Bob ke $100 ground floor se shuru hote hain — aur agar wahan euro khatam ho to order upar jata hai. Neeche poora flow dekhte hain.

2. $100 ka safar — step by step

Bob $100 bhejta hai, Alice ko €88 milte hain. Har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Steps 1–2: Bob paise bhejta hai

Step 1: Bob $100 PayPal se bhejta hai. Paise Bob ke bank (Bank B) se PayPal ke account (Bank P1) me jate hain.

Step 2: PayPal ko USD ko EUR me badalna hai. Wo foreign exchange provider (Bank E) ko use karta hai — PayPal $100 apne USD account (Bank E me) ko bhejta hai.

Rate yaad rakh lo: $100 = €88 — matlab exchange rate ~1.136 $/€. Rate har pal badalta hai — market pe depend karta hai.

Steps 3–4: Funding pool se exchange

Step 3: $100 Bank E ke funding pool ko beche jate hain — funding pool retail market ka hissa hai, jahan currencies ka stock rakha hota hai.

Step 4: Funding pool $100 ke badle €88 deta hai. Ye euros PayPal ke EUR account (Bank E me) me dal diye jate hain.

Funding pool kyun: PayPal pehle se kuch foreign currency khareed ke rakhta hai (advance me) — taaki har payment pe market se khareedna na pade. Isse speed aur efficiency milti hai.

Steps 5–6: Alice ko euros milte hain

Step 5: PayPal ka EUR account Bank P2 me €88 receive karta hai.

Step 6: €88 Alice ke EUR account (Bank A) me pay kiye jate hain. Alice ko euros mil gaye — Bob ke $100 ka safar poora hua.

Total time: minutes se leke 1–2 din — provider aur rails pe depend karta hai. Fees: exchange rate me chhupa spread + kabhi-kabhi alag fee.

Forex market ki 3 layers

Retail market: funding pools yahin hain. PayPal jaise players advance me currency khareed ke rakhte hain taaki payments tez hon.

Wholesale market: investment banks, commercial banks aur FX providers — jab retail ke pools khaali hone lagein to yahan se lete hain. Accumulated orders yahan handle hote hain.

Top-level participants: multinational commercial banks — jinke paas alag-alag deshon ki bahut saari currency hai. Jab wholesale market me bhi kami ho to yahan se aata hai.

Flow upar ki taraf: funding pool ko EUR chahiye → wholesale market (steps 3.1–3.3) → top-level participants (steps 4.1–4.3). Har layer upar wali se badi quantity handle karti hai.

3. $100 ka flow — ek table me

StepKya hota haiPaise kahan
1Bob PayPal se $100 bhejta haiBank B → PayPal (Bank P1)
2PayPal FX provider (Bank E) ko $100 bhejta haiPayPal USD account (Bank E)
3$100 funding pool ko becheBank E funding pool
4Pool €88 deta haiPayPal EUR account (Bank E)
5€88 PayPal ke EUR account meBank P2
6€88 Alice koAlice EUR account (Bank A)
// Exchange rate aur spread — paise kahan kat-te hain?
// Market rate: $100 = €90 (asli rate)
// Tumhe mila:  $100 = €88
// Spread: €2 (2%) — yehi FX provider ki kamai hai
// Plus: kabhi-kabhi alag se transfer fee bhi lagti hai.
// Isliye alag providers ke rates compare karo —
// "zero fee" ka matlab aksar "bura rate" hota hai!

Spread yaad rakh lo: jo rate tumhe milta hai wo market rate se hamesha thoda kharab hota hai — fark hi provider ki kamai hai. “Zero fee” wale providers aksar spread me paise banate hain.

4. Try karo — forex simulator

4. Try karo — forex simulator

$100 bhejo aur dekho wo euros me kaise badalte hain — aur rate badalne pe kya hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • $100 -> Alice (normal rate)
  • Bura rate: spread zyada hai
  • Funding pool khaali — upar jana padega

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Forex Simulator: Bob $100 -> Alice (EUR) ---

  • Market rate: $100 = €90

[Normal] PayPal: $100 Bank E ko bheje -> funding pool se €88 mile (spread €2).

  • Alice ko €88 mile. Total time: kuch minute. Fee: spread me chhupi hui.

[Bura Rate] Kisi provider ne rate diya: $100 = €82!

  • Spread: €8 (9%)! "Zero fee" likha tha, lekin rate me hi paise kaat liye.
  • Lesson: fee mat dekho, RATE dekho — final amount compare karo.

[Pool Khaali] Funding pool me EUR khatam!

  • Order upar gaya: Wholesale market (steps 3.1-3.3) -> Top-level banks (steps 4.1-4.3).
  • EUR mil gaye, lekin time zyada laga (1-2 din) aur rate thoda kharab mila.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Forex me rate hi sab kuch hai — spread me provider ki kamai chhupi hoti hai. Hamesha final amount compare karo.

5. Forex market ki 3 layers

LayerKaunKya karta hai
RetailPayPal, funding poolsChhote orders, advance stock
WholesaleInvestment/commercial banks, FX providersAccumulated orders handle karna
Top-levelMultinational banksSabse badi quantities, global stock

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Sirf fee dekhna, rate nahi — “zero fee” ka matlab aksar kharab exchange rate hota hai. Final amount (kitne euros milenge) compare karo.
2. Rate lock na karna — rate har pal badalta hai. Bade amount pe rate lock karo ya limit order lagao.
3. Weekend pe forex karna — market band hota hai, rate kharab milta hai aur settlement Monday ko hota hai.
4. Spread ko ignore karna — har provider spread leta hai. Alag providers ke spreads compare karo.
5. Exchange rate ke saath hidden fees ignore karna — dikh raha rate aksar real rate nahi hota; markup rate me chhupa hota hai. Hamesha total cost (rate + fee) dekho, sirf rate nahi.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Foreign exchange payment kaise kaam karta hai?””
A: Bob $100 PayPal se bhejta hai → PayPal FX provider (Bank E) ko $100 bhejta hai → $100 funding pool ko beche jate hain → pool €88 deta hai → euros PayPal ke EUR account me aate hain → Alice ke account me €88 pay hote hain. Beech me exchange rate aur spread lagta hai. Agar funding pool khaali ho to order wholesale market aur phir top-level banks tak jata hai.
Q: ““Spread kya hai?””
A: Market rate aur tumhe mile rate ka fark. Market rate $100 = €90 ho, lekin tumhe €88 mile — €2 ka fark hi spread hai, jo FX provider ki kamai hai. “Zero fee” wale providers aksar spread me paise banate hain — isliye final amount compare karo, fee nahi.
Q: ““Forex market ki 3 layers kaunsi hain?””
A: Retail (funding pools — PayPal advance me currency rakhta hai), Wholesale (investment/commercial banks — accumulated orders), aur Top-level (multinational banks — sabse bada stock). Jab neeche wali layer me currency khatam ho to order upar jata hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Market rate $100 = €90 hai, lekin tumhe €88 mile. €2 ka fark kya hai?

  • ✓ Spread — FX provider ki kamai, rate me chhupi hui — sahi jawab
  • Government tax
  • Bank ki galti

2. Funding pool me EUR khatam ho gaye. Ab kya hoga?

  • ✓ Order wholesale market ko jayega, phir top-level banks tak — sahi jawab
  • Payment fail ho jayega
  • Bob ko dollars wapas mil jayenge
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Forex = $100 funding pool se €88 me badalna. 3 layers hain — retail (pools), wholesale (banks), top-level (multinational banks). Rate hi sab kuch hai — spread me provider ki kamai chhupi hai, isliye final amount compare karo.

16Payment and Fintech

How to Avoid Double Payment

Customer se $10 ek baar katne the — kat gaye $20. Double payment payment system ki sabse serious problem hai. Isse rokne ke liye exactly-once guarantee chahiye — jo do hisson se banti hai: at-least-once (retry) + at-most-once (idempotency). Is page me dono deep me — retry kaise karein aur idempotency key kaise kaam karti hai.

1. Exactly-once matlab ek hi baar, pakka

Socho tum dost ko ₹100 bhejte ho — network fail ho gaya, pata nahi paise gaye ya nahi. Dobara bhej do to do baar kat sakte hain. Na bhejo to ek baar bhi nahi gaye. Solution: retry karo (kam se kam ek baar to jayenge) + pehchan rakho (dost ko pata ho “ye wahi ₹100 hain, dobara mat lo” — idempotency key). Dono mil ke exactly-once banta hai.

Mathematically: exactly-once = at-least-once + at-most-once. Neeche dono dekhte hain.

2. Retry aur Idempotency — dono hisse

Pehle retry (at-least-once), phir idempotency (at-most-once).

Retry — At-least-once guarantee

Network error ya timeout aaye to request dobara bhejo. Client $10 ka payment karta hai, network kharab hai — pehle 3 attempts fail, 4th attempt me success. Retry ki wajah se payment kam se kam ek baar to hua.

Retry kaise karein: exponential backoff — 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s ka gap — taaki down system ko aur na maaro. Jitter bhi jodo — taaki saare clients ek saath retry na karein (thundering herd). Max retries rakho — infinite retry se system mar jayega.

Problem: retry se payment do baar bhi ho sakta hai — pehli request actually success hui thi, bas response kho gaya. Isliye retry akele kaafi nahi — idempotency chahiye.

Idempotency — At-most-once guarantee

Idempotency ka matlab: ek hi call ko baar-baar karo to result ek hi ho. Payment API me ye idempotency key se hota hai — client har payment request ke saath ek unique key bhejta hai (aksar UUID), HTTP header me: Idempotency-Key: <uuid>.

Server kya karta hai: key pehli baar aaye to payment process karo aur result ko key ke saath store kar lo. Wahi key dobara aaye to payment dobara mat karo — pehle wala stored result wapas bhej do. Client ko lagega payment ek hi baar hua.

Key ki expiry: key kuch time ke baad expire ho jati hai (jaise 24 ghante) — taaki storage bhar na jaye. Stripe aur PayPal dono yehi recommend karte hain.

Dono mil ke — Exactly-once

Retry bina idempotency: payment ho sakta hai 2 baar (double charge). Idempotency bina retry: pehli request fail ho to payment kabhi hoga hi nahi.

Dono saath: client retry karta hai (at-least-once) + server idempotency key check karta hai (at-most-once) = exactly-once. Client ko 4th attempt me success milta hai, aur server ne payment sirf ek baar process kiya.

Important: idempotency key client banata hai — server nahi. Kyunki retry client karta hai, isliye use hi pata hai kaunsi requests ek hi payment ki retry hain.

Idempotency key design — practical baatein

Key kya ho: UUID (random, unique). Har naye payment ke liye nayi key. Retry ke liye wahi key dobara bhejo.

Server pe storage: key → result ka mapping DB ya Redis me store karo. Request aate hi pehle key check karo — mili to stored result wapas bhejo, nahi mili to process karo.

Race condition: do requests ek hi key ke saath ek saath aayein to dono process na karein — isliye key pe lock ya unique constraint lagao. Pehli request key ko “processing” mark kare, dusri wait kare.

Expiry: key ko 24 ghante baad expire kar do — uske baad wahi key dobara use ho to naya payment samjho.

3. Exactly-once ka formula + code

PartGuaranteeKaiseNahi ho to
RetryAt-least-onceExponential backoff + jitter + max retriesPayment kabhi hoga hi nahi
IdempotencyAt-most-onceIdempotency-Key header (UUID)Double charge
Dono saathExactly-onceRetry + key check—
// Client side — retry with same idempotency key
const key = crypto.randomUUID();  // ek payment = ek key
for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 4; attempt++) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/pay', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': key },  // har retry me WAHI key
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: 10 })
    });
    if (res.ok) return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    await sleep(1000 * 2 ** attempt + Math.random() * 500); // backoff + jitter
  }
}

// Server side — key check pehle
async function pay(req) {
  const key = req.headers['idempotency-key'];
  const cached = await db.findIdempotency(key);
  if (cached) return cached.result;        // dobara process mat karo!
  const result = await processPayment(req.body);  // ek hi baar
  await db.saveIdempotency(key, result);   // result store karo
  return result;
}

4. Try karo — double payment simulator

4. Try karo — double payment simulator

Network kharab hai — $10 ka payment karo. Dekho retry aur idempotency ke bina kya hota hai, aur unke saath kya hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • Retry ON, Idempotency OFF
  • Retry ON, Idempotency ON
  • Retry OFF, Idempotency ON

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Double Payment Simulator: $10 payment, kharab network ---

[Retry ON, Idempotency OFF] Attempt 1: request gayi, response kho gaya (timeout).

  • Attempt 2: retry bheja — server ne dobara process kiya. Attempt 3: phir timeout, phir retry.
  • Attempt 4: success! Lekin server ne payment 3 BAAR process kiya — $30 kat gaye!
  • DOUBLE (TRIPLE) CHARGE! Customer gussa, refund ka jhanjhat.

[Retry ON, Idempotency ON] Idempotency-Key: a1b2-c3d4 (har retry me wahi key)

  • Attempt 1: process hua, lekin response kho gaya. Attempt 2: server ne key pehchani — "ye to pehle ho chuka" — stored result wapas bheja.
  • Attempt 3-4: same — stored result. Total charge: $10, EXACTLY ONCE.
  • Client ko 4th attempt me success mila, server ne ek hi baar charge kiya.

[Retry OFF] Attempt 1: timeout — payment hua ya nahi, pata nahi.

  • Retry nahi kiya — payment atak gaya. Customer ko pata nahi paise gaye ya nahi.
  • At-most-once to hai (double charge nahi), lekin at-least-once nahi — payment hua hi nahi!
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Exactly-once = Retry (at-least-once) + Idempotency (at-most-once). Ek bhi missing ho to ya double charge hoga ya payment atak jayega.

5. Kahan idempotency lagani hai

OperationIdempotent?Kyun
Payment charge✅ Honi chahiyeDouble charge = paise ka nuksaan
Order create✅ Honi chahiyeDo order na ban jayein
Refund✅ Honi chahiyeDouble refund = loss
GET (read)✅ By natureRead se kuch badalta nahi
DELETE✅ By natureDo baar delete = ek hi result

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Retry bina idempotency ke — double charge pakka. Retry aur idempotency hamesha saath me lagao.
2. Har retry pe nayi key banana — nayi key ka matlab naya payment. Retry me wahi key dobara bhejo.
3. Idempotency key ko server pe banana — key client ko banani hai, kyunki retry client karta hai.
4. Key ko hamesha ke liye store karna — storage bhar jayega. 24 ghante ki expiry rakho.
5. Race condition ignore karna — ek hi key ki do requests ek saath aayein to lock/unique constraint lagao.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Exactly-once kaise achieve karte ho?””
A: Exactly-once = at-least-once + at-most-once. At-least-once retry se milta hai (exponential backoff ke saath). At-most-once idempotency key se milta hai — client har request ke saath UUID bhejta hai (Idempotency-Key header), server key check karke dobara process nahi karta, pehle wala result wapas bhej deta hai.
Q: ““Idempotency key kaun banata hai — client ya server?””
A: Client banata hai — kyunki retry client karta hai, isliye use hi pata hai kaunsi requests ek hi payment ki retry hain. Server sirf key ko store aur check karta hai.
Q: ““Retry me exponential backoff kyun?””
A: Taaki down system ko aur na maaro. Agar har client ek saath retry kare to thundering herd ho jata hai — system kabhi upar nahi aata. Backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) + jitter (random gap) se retries spread ho jate hain.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Payment request timeout hui — pata nahi paise kate ya nahi. Sahi approach kya hai?

  • ✓ Wahi idempotency key ke saath retry karo — server dobara charge nahi karega — sahi jawab
  • Nayi key ke saath dobara payment karo
  • Retry mat karo — chhod do

2. Exactly-once guarantee ka formula kya hai?

  • ✓ At-least-once (retry) + At-most-once (idempotency) — sahi jawab
  • Sirf retry karna
  • Sirf idempotency key lagana
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Double charge rokne ka formula: Retry + Idempotency Key = Exactly-once. Key client banata hai (UUID), har retry me wahi key jati hai, server dobara process nahi karta — pehla result wapas bhejta hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-to-avoid-double-payment.md

17Payment and Fintech

How do Apple Pay and Google Pay work?

Apple Pay aur Google Pay — dono se tap karke pay karte ho, dono secure hain. Lekin andar se dono bilkul alag kaam karte hain: Apple tumhare card ki info kabhi store nahi karta, Google apne server pe store karta hai. Is page me dono ke registration aur payment flows — step by step — aur samjhenge ki kaunsa zyada private hai.

1. Apple Pay matlab chaabi tumhare paas, Google Pay matlab chaabi Google ke paas

Socho tumhare ghar ki chaabi hai. Apple Pay matlab chaabi ki ek copy tumhari jeb me hai (iPhone ka secure chip) — koi aur us chaabi ko dekh bhi nahi sakta. Google Pay matlab chaabi Google ke locker me hai — tum mangte ho to Google tumhari taraf se darwaza kholta hai. Dono se ghar khulta hai, lekin chaabi kahan hai — yehi fark hai.

Dono me card ki asli info kabhi merchant tak nahi pahunchti — uski jagah ek token jata hai. Neeche dono flows dekhte hain.

2. Do flows — registration aur payment

Har tab ek flow hai — Apple vs Google, side by side.

Registration flow (Steps 1–3) — card add karna

Apple Pay: Apple tumhare card ki info store nahi karta. Wo card info bank ko pass karta hai. Bank ek token — DAN (Device Account Number) — return karta hai. iPhone DAN ko ek special hardware chip (Secure Element) me store karta hai.

Google Pay: tum card register karte ho to card info Google ke server pe store hoti hai. Google ek payment token return karta hai jo phone pe store hota hai.

Farak: Apple me card info sirf bank ke paas hai; Google me Google ke paas bhi hai. Apple ka approach zyada private hai.

Apple Pay — payment flow

Tum “Pay” dabate ho → e-commerce server ko DAN milta hai (tumhare iPhone ke Secure Element se) → server DAN ko bank ko bhejta hai → bank DAN se tumhara asli card dhoondh ke payment approve karta hai.

Key point: card ki asli info (card number) kabhi network pe nahi aati — sirf DAN aata hai. DAN leak bhi ho jaye to wo sirf tumhare iPhone se kaam karta hai — koi aur use nahi kar sakta.

Security: har payment pe Face ID / Touch ID chahiye — tumhari marzi ke bina payment nahi ho sakta.

Google Pay — payment flow

Tum “Pay” dabate ho → e-commerce server ko payment token milta hai → server token ko Google server ko bhejta hai → Google server token se tumhara card dhoondh ke card info bank ko bhejta hai → bank payment approve karta hai.

Key point: beech me ek extra step hai — Google server. Card info Google ke paas hai, isliye Google use bank ko bhejta hai.

Diagram me laal teer (red arrow): jahan card info public network pe available hoti hai (encrypted hone ke baad bhi) — Google Pay ke flow me ye step hai, Apple Pay me nahi. Isi liye Apple ka flow zyada private mana jata hai.

Tokenization — dono ka common idea

Dono me ek hi concept hai: tokenization — asli card number ki jagah ek token use karna. Token leak bhi ho jaye to asli card safe hai — token ko band kar do, card ko nahi.

Apple ka token: DAN — device-specific, Secure Element me stored. Google ka token: payment token — Google server se linked.

Tokenization vs Encryption: encryption me data ko code me badla jata hai (wapas khul sakta hai); tokenization me asli data ki jagah ek random number rakh diya jata hai (asli data sirf bank/Google ke paas hai).

3. Apple Pay vs Google Pay — side by side

CheezApple PayGoogle Pay
Card info kahan storeKahin nahi (sirf bank ke paas)Google server pe
TokenDAN (Device Account Number)Payment token
Token kahan storeiPhone Secure Element (hardware chip)Phone pe (token)
Payment flowDAN → Bank (direct)Token → Google Server → Bank
Extra stepNahiHaan (Google server)
Card info network peKabhi nahiEncrypted, lekin aati hai (red arrow)
AuthenticationFace ID / Touch IDScreen lock / biometrics
// Apple Pay flow — ek line me
iPhone (DAN from Secure Element) -> Merchant -> Bank -> Approve
// Card number kahin nahi gaya — sirf DAN gaya.

// Google Pay flow — ek line me
Phone (Payment Token) -> Merchant -> Google Server -> Bank -> Approve
// Google server beech me hai — card info Google ke paas hai.

4. Try karo — Apple Pay vs Google Pay simulator

4. Try karo — Apple Pay vs Google Pay simulator

Dono se pay karo — dekho card info kahan-kahan jati hai.

Scenarios:

  • Apple Pay se ₹2,000 pay karo
  • Google Pay se ₹2,000 pay karo

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Apple Pay vs Google Pay Simulator: ₹2,000 ---

[Apple Pay] Face ID verify hua.

  • iPhone ke Secure Element se DAN nikla: DAN **** 4242
  • Merchant -> Bank: DAN bheja. Bank ne DAN se asli card dhoondha -> APPROVED.
  • Card number kahin nahi gaya — na merchant ko, na Apple ko, na network pe.
  • Privacy: MAXIMUM. Apple ko pata bhi nahi tumne kya khareeda.

[Google Pay] Screen lock verify hua.

  • Phone se Payment Token nikla -> Merchant -> Google Server.
  • Google Server ne token se card info nikali -> Bank ko bheji -> APPROVED.
  • Card info Google ke server pe hai — aur payment ke time network pe aati hai (encrypted).
  • Privacy: GOOD, lekin Apple se kam — Google ko tumhare card ki info hai.
  • Koi option nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Pay karo dabao.

SABAK: Dono secure hain — lekin Apple card info kabhi store nahi karta, Google karta hai. Tokenization dono me hai.

5. Tokenization kyun zaroori hai

CheezBina tokenizationTokenization ke saath
Card leak ho toAsli card number leak — card band karna padegaSirf token leak — token band karo, card safe
Merchant ke paasTumhara card numberSirf token
PCI complianceMerchant ko heavy complianceMerchant ko card milta hi nahi — compliance kam

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Tokenization ko encryption samajhna — encryption reversible hai (key se khul jata hai); tokenization me asli data sirf bank ke paas hai.
2. “Apple Pay = Google Pay” samajhna — dono ke flows alag hain. Interview me fark poochte hain.
3. Card info merchant ko dena — kabhi mat do. Hamesha tokenized payment use karo.
4. Biometrics ke bina pay karna — Face ID/fingerprint ke bina phone milne pe koi bhi pay kar sakta hai. Biometrics ON rakho.
5. Real card number phone me save samajhna — Apple/Google Pay card number store nahi karte; tokenization hoti hai — ek device-specific token banta hai. Card kho jaye to token revoke hota hai, card nahi.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Apple Pay aur Google Pay me kya fark hai?””
A: Dono tokenization use karte hain, lekin card info kahan store hoti hai — yehi fark hai. Apple Pay card info kabhi store nahi karta — bank DAN (Device Account Number) deta hai jo iPhone ke Secure Element chip me store hota hai, aur payment me DAN seedha bank ko jata hai. Google Pay card info Google server pe store karta hai — payment me token Google server ko jata hai, Google card info bank ko bhejta hai. Apple ka flow zyada private hai.
Q: ““DAN kya hai?””
A: Device Account Number — bank ke dwara diya gaya ek token jo tumhare asli card number ki jagah leta hai. Ye device-specific hota hai aur iPhone ke Secure Element (hardware chip) me store hota hai. DAN leak bhi ho jaye to wo sirf usi iPhone se kaam karta hai.
Q: ““Tokenization kya hai?””
A: Asli sensitive data (card number) ki jagah ek random token use karna. Token leak ho bhi jaye to asli data safe hai — token ko band kar do. Encryption se fark ye hai ki tokenization me asli data token se derive nahi ho sakta — wo sirf bank/token vault ke paas hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Apple Pay me tumhare card ki asli info kahan store hoti hai?

  • ✓ Kahin nahi — sirf bank ke paas; iPhone me sirf DAN token hota hai — sahi jawab
  • Apple ke server pe
  • Merchant ke paas

2. Google Pay ke flow me Apple Pay se extra step kaunsa hai?

  • ✓ Payment token Google server ko jata hai, Google card info bank ko bhejta hai — sahi jawab
  • Google Pay me koi token nahi hota
  • Google Pay seedha bank ko card bhejta hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Dono tokenization use karte hain — asli card kabhi merchant tak nahi pahunchta. Apple card info store hi nahi karta (DAN Secure Element me), Google apne server pe store karta hai. Isliye Apple ka flow zyada private hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-applegoogle-pay-works.md

18Payment and Fintech

How VISA Works When Swiping a Credit Card

Tum dukaan pe card swipe karte ho — 2 second me “approved” aata hai. Lekin paise dukaan ko us time nahi milte — pehle authorization hota hai, phir capture aur settlement. Is page me VISA ka poora flow — authorization flow (swipe ke time) aur capture/settlement flow (din ke end me) — step by step.

1. Card payment matlab pehle vaada, phir paise

Socho tum dukaan se ₹1000 ka saaman lete ho aur kehte ho “paise shaam ko dunga” — dukaan wala tumhara naam likh leta hai (authorization — paise reserve ho gaye). Shaam ko tum paise dete ho (capture + settlement — paise actually milte hain). Card payment me wahi hota hai: swipe ke time bank sirf vaada karta hai (paise freeze), paise din ke end me hilte hain.

Visa beech me middleman hai — jo saare banks ko jodta hai taaki har bank ko har bank se alag deal na karni pade. Neeche dono flows dekhte hain.

2. Do flows — authorization aur capture/settlement

Har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Authorization Flow — swipe ke time (Steps 0–4)

Step 0: Issuing bank customer ko credit card issue karta hai.

Step 1: Cardholder dukaan pe POS terminal pe card swipe karta hai.

Step 2: POS terminal transaction ko acquiring bank ko bhejta hai (jisne POS diya hai).

Steps 3–4: Acquiring bank transaction ko card network (Visa) ko bhejta hai → network use issuing bank ko bhejta hai approval ke liye.

Steps 4.1–4.3: Issuing bank approve kare to paise freeze kar deta hai. Approval ya rejection wapas acquirer aur POS terminal ko bhej di jati hai — 2 second me “approved” dikhta hai.

Yaad rakh lo: authorization pe paise hilte nahi — sirf freeze hote hain. Tumhare account me paise kam dikhenge, lekin dukaan ko abhi nahi mile.

Capture & Settlement Flow — din ke end me (Steps 1–5)

Steps 1–2: Din ke end me merchant POS pe “capture” dabata hai. Saari transactions batch me acquirer ko jati hain → acquirer batch file card network ko bhejta hai.

Step 3: Card network clearing karta hai — alag-alag acquirers se aaye transactions ko net karta hai aur clearing files alag-alag issuing banks ko bhejta hai.

Step 4: Issuing banks clearing files ki correctness confirm karte hain aur paise acquiring banks ko transfer karte hain.

Step 5: Acquiring bank paise merchant ke bank ko transfer karta hai. Ab dukaan ko paise mile — 1–2 din baad.

Clearing yaad rakh lo: mutual transactions ko net karke total transactions kam karna — taaki kam paise hilne padein.

Visa ka role — middleman kyun chahiye?

Bina Visa ke har bank ko har bank se alag settlement karna padta — 1000 banks hon to ~500,000 connections! Visa beech me aake sabko jodta hai — har bank sirf Visa se baat karta hai.

Visa kya karta hai: transactions route karna, clearing karna (netting), rules banana, aur fraud detection. Badle me wo service fees leta hai (Page 191 me detail).

Visa paise nahi rakhta — wo sirf network hai. Paise banks ke paas hote hain.

3. Authorization vs Capture — ek table me

CheezAuthorizationCapture + Settlement
KabSwipe ke time (2 second)Din ke end me (1–2 din)
Kya hota haiPaise freeze hote hainPaise actually hilte hain
Merchant ko paiseNahi mileMil gaye
Fail ho to“Declined” — paise freeze nahi hoteClearing file mismatch — investigation
// Authorization flow — ek line me
Cardholder -> POS -> Acquiring Bank -> Visa -> Issuing Bank
   (approve + freeze) <- Visa <- Acquiring Bank <- POS
// Time: ~2 seconds. Paise: freeze hue, hile nahi.

// Capture + Settlement flow — ek line me
Merchant (capture) -> Acquirer (batch) -> Visa (clearing/netting)
  -> Issuing Banks (confirm + pay) -> Acquiring Banks -> Merchant
// Time: 1-2 din. Paise: actually hilte hain.

4. Try karo — Visa payment simulator

4. Try karo — Visa payment simulator

Card swipe karo — dekho authorization kaise hota hai, aur din ke end me paise kaise pahunchte hain.

Scenarios:

  • Card swipe: ₹2,000 ki khareed
  • Din ke end: Capture + Settlement
  • Card decline: limit khatam

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- VISA Payment Simulator ---

[Authorization] Tumne POS pe card swipe kiya — ₹2,000.

  • POS -> Acquiring Bank -> Visa -> Issuing Bank (HDFC).
  • HDFC: balance check OK -> ₹2,000 FREEZE kiye -> APPROVED wapas bheja.
  • POS pe "APPROVED" dikha — 2 second me. Paise abhi dukaan ko NAHI mile — sirf freeze hue.

[Capture + Settlement] Din ke end me merchant ne Capture dabaya.

  • Saari transactions batch me Acquirer ko gayi -> Visa ne clearing ki (netting).
  • Issuing banks ne confirm kiya -> paise Acquiring banks ko -> Merchant ke bank ko.
  • Dukaan ko ₹2,000 mile — 1-2 din baad. Authorization aur settlement ka fark yehi hai.

[DECLINED] Issuing Bank ne check kiya — card limit khatam!

  • Bank ne DECLINE bheja — Visa -> Acquirer -> POS: "DECLINED".
  • Paise freeze nahi hue, kuch kata nahi. Tumhe dusra card ya cash use karna padega.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Swipe pe sirf vaada milta hai (authorization) — paise din ke end me hilte hain (capture + settlement). Visa beech ka middleman hai.

5. Card payment ke players

PlayerKaam
CardholderCard se pay karta hai
Merchant + POSCard swipe karta hai, capture karta hai
Acquiring BankMerchant ka bank — POS deta hai
Card Network (Visa)Banks ko jodta hai, clearing karta hai
Issuing BankCard deta hai, approve karta hai, paise freeze karta hai

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Authorization ko payment samajhna — swipe pe paise nahi milte, sirf freeze hote hain. Settlement baad me hota hai.
2. Capture karna bhoolna — merchant capture na dabaye to paise kabhi nahi milenge, chahe authorization ho gaya ho. Capture automate karo.
3. Visa ko bank samajhna — Visa paise nahi rakhta, wo network hai. Paise banks ke paas hote hain.
4. Authorization hold ko charge samajhna — hotel/petrol pump pe hold dikhe to ghabrao mat — wo freeze hai, charge nahi. Capture na ho to hold chhoot jata hai.
5. Authorization ko payment samajhna — swipe pe sirf authorization hota hai (paise hold), asli payment settlement me hota hai. Isi liye refund ya void authorization stage pe bhi ho sakta hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Card swipe karne pe kya hota hai?””
A: Do flows hain. Authorization: POS → Acquiring Bank → Visa → Issuing Bank — bank approve kare to paise freeze ho jate hain aur “approved” wapas aata hai (2 second). Capture + Settlement: din ke end me merchant capture karta hai → batch acquirer ko → Visa clearing (netting) karta hai → issuing banks paise acquirers ko dete hain → merchant ko milte hain (1–2 din).
Q: ““Authorization aur capture me kya farak hai?””
A: Authorization pe paise sirf freeze hote hain — merchant ko nahi milte. Capture pe merchant paise claim karta hai — phir clearing aur settlement se paise actually hilte hain. Bina capture ke authorization ka koi matlab nahi — paise kabhi nahi milenge.
Q: ““Visa ki zaroorat kyun hai — bank seedha bank se baat kyun nahi karte?””
A: Kyunki har bank ko har bank se connect karna impossible hai — 1000 banks hon to ~500,000 connections chahiye. Visa beech me ek hub hai — har bank sirf Visa se baat karta hai. Plus Visa clearing (netting), rules aur fraud detection bhi karta hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Card swipe karke “approved” aaya. Kya dukaan ko paise mil gaye?

  • ✓ Nahi — sirf authorization hua hai (paise freeze); paise capture + settlement ke baad milenge (1–2 din) — sahi jawab
  • Haan — approve hote hi paise mil jate hain
  • Paise Visa ke paas hain

2. Merchant ne din ke end me capture nahi kiya. Kya hoga?

  • ✓ Paise kabhi nahi milenge — authorization hold kuch din me chhoot jayega — sahi jawab
  • Paise apne aap mil jayenge
  • Visa paise de dega
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Card swipe = vaada (authorization, paise freeze), din ke end = paise (capture + settlement). Visa beech ka hub hai jo saare banks ko jodta hai aur clearing karta hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-does-visa-work-when-we-swipe-a-credit-card-at-a-merchant's-shop.md

19Payment and Fintech

How ACH Payment Works

Salary kaise aati hai? US me most companies ACH (Automated Clearing House) se payroll karti hain. ACH real-time nahi hai — ye batch system hai: transactions din bhar collect hote hain, raat ko process hote hain, aur paise agle din subah milte hain. Is page me ACH direct deposit ka poora flow — ODFI, RDFI aur cut-off time ke saath.

1. ACH matlab dakiya jo din me ek baar aata hai

Socho ek dakiya hai jo din me ek baar shaam ko aata hai — saari chithhiyan ek saath le jata hai, raat ko sorting hoti hai, aur subah delivery hoti hai. UPI ek bike courier hai — turant pahunchata hai. ACH wo dakiya hai — batch me, slow lekin sasta aur reliable. Salary, bills, subscriptions — jo kaam turant nahi chahiye, wo ACH se hota hai.

Neeche payroll ka example dekhte hain — company se employee tak.

2. ACH direct deposit — step by step

Company apne employees ko salary deti hai. Har tab flow ka ek hissa hai.

Step 0: Setup — ODFI aur authorization

ACH use karne se pehle originator (company) ko ek commercial bank me account kholna padta hai — kyunki sirf banks hi ACH transactions seedha initiate kar sakte hain. Us bank ko ODFI (Originating Depository Financial Institution) kehte hain.

Phir transaction receiver (employee) ko originator ko authorize karna padta hai — “haan, tum mere account me paise bhej sakte ho”. Bina authorization ke ACH transaction nahi ho sakta.

Terms yaad rakh lo: ODFI = bhejne wale ka bank; RDFI (Receiving Depository Financial Institution) = paane wale ka bank.

Steps 1–2: ACH file banao aur bhejo

Step 1: Originator company salary payment transactions banati hai aur 3rd-party processor (jaise Gusto) ko bhejti hai. Processor ACH-related services me help karta hai — jaise ACH files banana.

Step 2: Processor company ki taraf se ACH files banata hai aur ODFI ke SFTP pe upload karta hai. Ye kaam 7 PM cut-off time se pehle hona chahiye (ODFI bank ke hisab se).

Cut-off yaad rakh lo: 7 PM ke baad file gayi to wo agle din process hogi — salary ek din late milegi.

Steps 3–5: Clearing, settlement aur paise milna

Step 3: Shaam ko business hours ke baad, ODFI bank ACH files ko ACH operator ko forward karta hai — clearing aur settlement ke liye. Do ACH operators hain: FedACH (Federal Reserve) aur EPN (Electronic Payments Network — private company).

Step 4: ACH files aadhi raat ke aas-paas process hoti hain aur receiving bank (RDFI) ko available ho jati hain.

Step 5: RDFI receiver ke bank accounts pe instructions execute karta hai — employee ko $100 milte hain. Ye agle din subah 6 AM hota hai jab RDFI business kholta hai.

Timing — ACH next-day settlement hai

7 PM tak file gayi to paise agle din subah milenge. Matlab ACH next-day settlement system hai — real-time nahi.

Same Day ACH: 2018 se Same Day ACH bhi hai — same business day me funds transfer ho sakte hain (lekin iske liye alag cut-off aur fees hoti hain).

UPI se comparison: UPI seconds me karta hai jo ACH 1 din me karta hai — lekin ACH US ka purana, bharosemand system hai jo har bank se connected hai.

3. ACH flow ek table me + timing

StepKaunKya hota haiKab
0Company + ODFIAccount kholo, authorization loPehle se
1Company → ProcessorSalary transactions bhejoDin me
2Processor → ODFIACH file banao, SFTP pe upload karo7 PM cut-off se pehle
3ODFI → OperatorFiles FedACH/EPN ko forward karoShaam (business hours ke baad)
4OperatorFiles process karo, RDFI ko doAadhi raat
5RDFI → Employee$100 account me daaloAgle din subah 6 AM
// ACH timeline — ek line me
// Day 1, 7 PM:  File upload (cut-off)
// Day 1, raat:  ODFI -> FedACH/EPN -> process
// Day 2, 6 AM:  RDFI paise daalta hai
// Total: ~12 ghante. Next-day settlement.
// Same Day ACH (2018+): same business day me —
//   lekin alag cut-off (subah) aur zyada fee.

4. Try karo — ACH payroll simulator

4. Try karo — ACH payroll simulator

Salary file bhejo — dekho paise kab pahunchte hain. Cut-off miss karke bhi dekho kya hota hai.

Scenarios:

  • File 5 PM pe bheji (cut-off se pehle)
  • File 9 PM pe bheji (cut-off ke baad)
  • Same Day ACH chuno

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- ACH Payroll Simulator: 100 employees, $100 each ---

[On Time] 5 PM: ACH file ODFI ke SFTP pe upload hui (cut-off 7 PM se pehle).

  • Raat: ODFI -> FedACH -> process hui (aadhi raat).
  • Agle din 6 AM: RDFI ne har employee ke account me $100 daale.
  • Salary time pe mili. Total: ~13 ghante (next-day settlement).

[LATE] 9 PM: File upload hui — cut-off (7 PM) miss ho gaya!

  • File agle din process hogi — paise uske agle din subah milenge.
  • Salary 1 DIN LATE! Employees naraz. Cut-off ka dhyan rakho.

[Same Day ACH] Subah file bheji — same business day me paise milenge.

  • Lekin: alag cut-off (subah), zyada fee, aur har bank support nahi karta.
  • Urgent payment ke liye theek hai, regular payroll ke liye normal ACH kaafi hai.
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: ACH batch system hai — file cut-off se pehle bhejo, paise agle din subah milenge. Turant chahiye to UPI/wire use karo.

5. ACH vs UPI vs Wire — comparison

CheezACHUPIWire Transfer
SpeedNext-day (1 din)SecondsSame day (ghante)
CostBahut kam (cents)Free (aksar)Zyada ($25+)
Batch ya real-timeBatchReal-timeReal-time
UsePayroll, bills, subscriptionsRoz ke paymentsBade, urgent payments
ReversibleHaan (kuch din tak)NahiNahi

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Cut-off time bhoolna — 7 PM ke baad file gayi to salary ek din late. Cut-off calendar me mark karo.
2. ACH ko real-time samajhna — ye batch system hai. Turant paise chahiye to ACH mat use karo.
3. Authorization ke bina debit karna — ACH debit ke liye receiver ki authorization zaroori hai. Bina iske transaction reverse ho jayega aur fine lagega.
4. Same Day ACH ko normal samajhna — iske alag cut-off, alag fees aur alag limits hain. Pehle bank se confirm karo.
5. ACH ko instant payment samajhna — ACH batch me chalta hai aur 1–3 business din lagte hain. Urgent payment ke liye wire transfer ya real-time rails chahiye — ACH nahi.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““ACH kaise kaam karta hai?””
A: ACH ek batch payment system hai. Company salary transactions banati hai → 3rd-party processor ACH file banake ODFI bank ke SFTP pe upload karta hai (7 PM cut-off se pehle) → ODFI files ko ACH operator (FedACH ya EPN) ko bhejta hai → files aadhi raat process hoti hain → RDFI agle din subah 6 AM paise employee ke account me daalta hai. Total next-day settlement.
Q: ““ODFI aur RDFI kya hain?””
A: ODFI (Originating Depository Financial Institution) bhejne wale ka bank hai — jo ACH transaction initiate karta hai. RDFI (Receiving Depository Financial Institution) paane wale ka bank hai — jo paise receiver ke account me daalta hai. Sirf banks hi ACH initiate kar sakte hain — companies ko ODFI ke through jana padta hai.
Q: ““ACH aur UPI me kya farak hai?””
A: ACH batch, next-day hai — files collect hoke raat ko process hoti hain, paise agle din subah milte hain. UPI real-time hai — seconds me paise pahunchte hain. ACH US ka purana system hai (payroll, bills), UPI India ka naya system hai (roz ke payments). Dono ka use case alag hai.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. Company ne salary file 9 PM pe bheji (cut-off 7 PM). Paise kab milenge?

  • ✓ Ek din late — file agle din process hogi, paise uske agle din subah — sahi jawab
  • Turant — ACH real-time hai
  • Raat 12 baje

2. ACH files ko process karke RDFI tak kaun pahunchata hai?

  • ✓ ACH Operator — FedACH ya EPN — sahi jawab
  • Visa
  • SWIFT
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: ACH dakiya hai — batch me, next-day settlement. File 7 PM cut-off se pehle bhejo to paise agle din subah 6 AM milenge. Payroll aur bills ke liye best hai; turant paise chahiye to ACH mat use karo.
