← PichhlaHow VISA Works When Swiping a Credit CardAgla →How does Visa make money?
20Payment and Fintech

How does Visa make money?

Credit card “banks ka sabse profitable product” kyun hai? Aur Visa/Mastercard paise kaise kamate hain — wo to bank bhi nahi hain! Is page me $100 ki khareed ka economics dekhenge — merchant discount fee, interchange fee, acquiring markup aur network assessment — har ek ka hissa kitna hai aur kiski jeb me jata hai.

1. $100 ki khareed me se kisko kitna milta hai?

Socho tum dukaan se ₹100 ka saaman khareedte ho. Dukaan ko ₹100 nahi milte — usme se kuch paise bank ko jate hain (kyunki bank ne tumhe credit diya aur risk liya), kuch Visa ko (kyunki usne network chalaya), aur kuch acquiring bank ko (kyunki usne dukaan ko POS diya). Dukaan ko ~₹97.75 milte hain — baaki ₹2.25 in teeno me bat jata hai. Tumhe koi extra charge nahi dikhta — kyunki dukaan ye cost apne daam me jod leti hai.

Neeche $100 ke example se har hissa dekhte hain.

2. $100 ka hisaab — step by step

Cardholder dukaan ko $100 deta hai. Har tab ek hissa hai.

Steps 1–2: Merchant Discount Fee

Step 1: Cardholder merchant ko $100 deta hai (card se).

Step 2: Merchant ko poora $100 nahi milta — use payment service ke liye compensate karna padta hai. Acquiring bank merchant se ek fee leta hai — merchant discount fee (jaise $2.00). Ye fee issuer aur card network ko compensate karne ke liye hoti hai.

Yaad rakh lo: merchant discount fee wo total hai jo merchant payment accept karne ke liye deta hai — isme se aage batwara hota hai.

Steps 3–4: Interchange Fee — sabse bada hissa

Step 3: Acquiring bank apna hissa rakhta hai — acquiring markup ($0.25).

Step 4: Baaki $1.75 issuing bank ko jata hai — interchange fee ke roop me. Interchange fee card network (Visa) set karta hai — kyunki har issuing bank ka har merchant se alag fee negotiate karna inefficient hota.

Interchange fee sabse bada hissa hai — $2.00 me se $1.75 issuer ko jata hai. Isi liye banks credit cards promote karte hain — har swipe pe unhe paise milte hain.

Step 5: Network Assessment — Visa ka hissa

Card network (Visa) har bank se network assessments aur fees leta hai — har mahine. Example: Visa 0.11% assessment + $0.0195 usage fee har swipe pe leta hai. $100 ki swipe pe ye ~$0.13 hota hai.

Visa ka hissa sabse chhota hai — lekin Visa ke paas billions of swipes hain — chhota hissa × billions = billions of dollars. Isi liye Visa itni badi company hai bina bank bane.

Step 6: Cardholder bhi deta hai

Cardholder issuing bank ko pay karta hai — annual fee, interest (agar bill time pe na bhare), late fees. Ye issuer ki kamai ka dusra hissa hai.

Issuer ko kyun compensate karte hain: (1) issuer merchant ko paise deta hai chahe cardholder pay kare ya na kare (risk). (2) issuer cardholder se pehle merchant ko deta hai (float). (3) issuer ke operating costs hain — account management, statements, fraud detection, risk management, clearing aur settlement.

Issuer ko itna kyun milta hai?

Kyunki issuer risk leta hai: agar cardholder pay na kare to bhi merchant ko paise milte hain — loss issuer ka. Issuer pehle deta hai: merchant ko paise turant (settlement pe) milte hain, cardholder 30–45 din baad deta hai — beech ka time issuer ka paise laga hota hai.

Aur issuer ke costs hain: fraud detection, customer service, statements, rewards (cashback/points) — ye sab interchange fee se hi chalta hai. Tumhara cashback bhi merchant ki fee se hi aata hai!

3. $100 ka poora hisaab — ek table me

StepKaunKitnaKyun
1Cardholder → Merchant$100.00Khareed
2Merchant discount fee−$2.00Payment service ki cost
3Acquiring markup$0.25Acquirer ka profit
4Interchange fee → Issuer$1.75Risk + float + costs
5Network assessment → Visa~$0.130.11% + $0.0195 per swipe
6Cardholder → IssuerFees + interestAnnual fee, interest, late fee
=Merchant ko mila~$98.00$100 − $2.00 fee
// $100 ki swipe ka hisaab
Merchant discount fee:  $2.00  (merchant deta hai)
  ├── Acquiring markup: $0.25  (acquirer rakhta hai)
  └── Interchange fee:  $1.75  (issuer ko jata hai)
Network assessment:     ~$0.13 (Visa ko — 0.11% + $0.0195)
Cardholder se issuer ko: annual fee + interest (alag se)

// Bade merchants ko chhota interchange milta hai!
// "Kya card network bade merchants se wahi fee leta hai?"
// Nahi — bade merchants (Amazon, Walmart) ko volume ki wajah se
// kam interchange rate milta hai — unki bargaining power zyada hai.

4. Try karo — $100 ka hisaab simulator

4. Try karo — $100 ka hisaab simulator

Khareed ki amount chuno — dekho $100 me se kisko kitna milta hai.

Scenarios:

  • $100 ki khareed
  • $10,000 ki khareed (bada merchant)
  • Cashback card: 2% rewards

Har scenario me kya hota hai:

--- Visa Money Simulator ---

[₹100 ki khareed — chhota merchant]

  • Merchant discount fee (2%): $2.00
  • Acquiring markup: $0.25 | Interchange (issuer): $1.75
  • Network assessment (Visa): $0.13 (0.11% + $0.0195)
  • Merchant ko mila: $98.00. Visa ko sirf $0.13 — lekin billions swipes se billions bante hain!

[$10,000 ki khareed — bada merchant (Amazon jaisa)]

  • Bade merchant ko kam rate milta hai: discount fee 1.2% = $120 (2% nahi!)
  • Acquiring markup: $15 | Interchange: $105 | Visa: ~$11.20
  • Merchant ko mila: $9,880. Volume ki bargaining power — bade ko chhota rate!

[Cashback card — 2% rewards]

  • Tumhe cashback mila: $2.00 (2% of $100). Ye paise kahan se aaye?
  • Interchange fee ($1.75) + issuer ki jeb se! Tumhara cashback merchant ki fee se aata hai.
  • Isi liye banks rewards dete hain — har swipe pe unhe $1.75 milte hain, usme se $2.00?
  • Wait — $1.75 se $2.00 cashback kaise? Issuer interest + annual fee se poora karta hai!
  • Koi scenario nahi chuna — upar se ek chuno, phir Run dabao.

SABAK: Credit card ka paisa merchant ki fee se aata hai — issuer ko sabse zyada, Visa ko sabse kam per swipe, lekin volume se sabse zyada.

5. Kaun kitna kamata hai — summary

PlayerKahan se kamata hai$100 pe
Issuing BankInterchange + interest + annual fee$1.75 + fees
Acquiring BankAcquiring markup$0.25
Card Network (Visa)Assessment + usage fee~$0.13
MerchantSales badhti hain (card se log zyada khareedte hain)$98.00 milta hai

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. “Visa paise rakhta hai” samajhna — Visa network hai, bank nahi. Uska hissa sabse chhota hai per swipe.
2. Interchange fee ko Visa ki kamai samajhna — interchange issuer ko jata hai, Visa ko nahi. Visa ko sirf assessment milta hai.
3. Cashback ko “free” samajhna — cashback merchant ki fee se aata hai, jo daam me jud ke tumse hi vasool hota hai.
4. Bade aur chhote merchant ko ek rate samajhna — bade merchants ko volume ki wajah se kam interchange milta hai.
5. Visa ko bank samajhna — Visa paise lend nahi karta aur tumhara account nahi rakhta. Ye sirf network hai — authorization, clearing aur settlement ki fee leta hai. Paise bank ka hota hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Visa paise kaise kamata hai?””
A: Visa network assessments aur fees se kamata hai — har swipe pe 0.11% assessment + $0.0195 usage fee (example). Per swipe hissa chhota hai (~$0.13 per $100), lekin billions of swipes se billions bante hain. Visa bank nahi hai — wo paise nahi rakhta, sirf network chalata hai.
Q: ““Interchange fee kya hai aur kisko milti hai?””
A: Interchange fee wo fee hai jo acquiring bank issuing bank ko deta hai — har card transaction pe. $100 ki khareed pe ~$1.75. Ye card network (Visa) set karta hai. Issuer ko isliye milti hai kyunki wo risk leta hai (cardholder na pay kare to bhi merchant ko deta hai), pehle paise deta hai, aur uske operating costs hain.
Q: ““Merchant discount fee kya hai?””
A: Wo total fee jo merchant payment accept karne ke liye deta hai — $100 pe ~$2.00. Isme se acquiring markup ($0.25) acquirer rakhta hai aur interchange fee ($1.75) issuer ko jati hai. Merchant ko $98 milte hain.

8. Quick check

8. Quick check

1. $100 ki card khareed pe sabse bada hissa kisko milta hai?

  • ✓ Issuing bank ko — interchange fee $1.75 — sahi jawab
  • Visa ko — $0.13
  • Acquiring bank ko — $0.25

2. Tumhara 2% cashback kahan se aata hai?

  • ✓ Merchant ki fee (interchange) se — issuer usme se rewards deta hai — sahi jawab
  • Visa apni jeb se deta hai
  • Government deti hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: $100 me se merchant ko ~$98 milte hain — $1.75 issuer ko (interchange), $0.25 acquirer ko, ~$0.13 Visa ko. Issuer sabse zyada kamata hai kyunki risk uska hai; Visa per swipe kam kamata hai lekin volume se sabse zyada.

4 labs — mushkil concepts ko haath se aazmao. Har lab ka output yahin live dikhta hai.

LABIdempotency Key Demo — Double Payment Rokna

₹100 bhejna hai. Pehli koshish me network timeout ho jata hai — pata nahi paise gaye ya nahi. Retry karo: idempotency key OFF ho to dobara kat jayega, ON ho to nahi. Pehle key OFF rakh ke dekho, phir ON karke dobara try karo.

    Interview FAQs

    12 FAQs — aaj ke era ke interviews me poochhe jaane wale sawaal, seedhe jawab ke saath. Sawaal par tap karo, jawab khulega.

    01UPI payment peeche se kaise kaam karta hai? NPCI kya karta hai?
    UPI me paise seedha bank se bank nahi jate — beech me NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) ek switch ki tarah kaam karta hai, jaise telephone exchange. Flow 3 phases me hota hai: (1) Registration — phone number + OTP se VPA banao (jaise bob@axis); (2) Bank linking — NPCI VPA se account resolve karta hai aur tum PIN set karte ho (2FA); (3) Payment — Alice PhonePe pe bob@axis + ₹100 daalti hai, request ICICI bank ke through NPCI ko jati hai, NPCI HDFC se ₹100 deduct karke SBI ko credit karne ka instruction bhejta hai, aur dono apps ko notify karta hai — paise seconds me pahunch jate hain. UPI India ke 60% digital retail transactions handle karta hai.
    02Double payment kaise rokte hain? Idempotency key kya hoti hai?
    Double payment tab hota hai jab network timeout pe pata nahi chalta paise gaye ya nahi, aur retry karne pe dobara kat jate hain — jaise $10 katne the, kat gaye $20. Solution hai exactly-once guarantee, jo do hisson se banti hai: at-least-once (retry karo, kam se kam ek baar to jayenge) + at-most-once (idempotency — har payment request ke saath ek unique key bhejo; server key dekh ke pehchan leta hai ki ye wahi payment hai, dobara process nahi karta). Mathematically: exactly-once = at-least-once + at-most-once. Idempotency key ko payment, order aur refund — teeno jagah lagana chahiye.
    03Authorization aur capture/settlement me kya farak hai? Card swipe pe paise kab hilte hain?
    Authorization pe paise hilte nahi — sirf freeze hote hain. Card swipe karte hi acquiring bank transaction card network (Visa) ko bhejta hai, network issuing bank ko bhejta hai approval ke liye; issuing bank approve kare to paise freeze kar deta hai aur approval wapas acquirer aur POS terminal ko bhej deta hai — ye sab ~2 second me hota hai. Tumhare account me paise kam dikhenge, lekin dukaan ko abhi nahi mile. Capture din ke end me hota hai — merchant POS pe capture dabata hai, transactions batch me acquirer ko jati hain. Settlement uske baad hota hai — card network clearing karta hai, issuing bank acquiring bank ko paise transfer karta hai, aur acquirer merchant ke bank ko deta hai. Tab jaake asli money movement hota hai.
    04Visa aur Mastercard bank bane bina paise kaise kamate hain?
    Visa/Mastercard bank nahi hain — wo card network (scheme) hain, aur unki kamai network assessment aur fees se hoti hai. Example: Visa har swipe pe 0.11% assessment + $0.0195 usage fee leta hai — $100 ki swipe pe ye ~$0.13 hota hai, sabse chhota hissa. Lekin Visa ke paas billions of swipes hain — chhota hissa × billions = billions of dollars. Bada hissa issuing bank ko jata hai: $100 ki khareed pe merchant discount fee $2.00 hoti hai, jisme se acquiring markup $0.25 acquirer rakhta hai aur interchange fee $1.75 issuing bank ko jati hai. Isi liye banks credit cards promote karte hain — har swipe pe unhe paise milte hain — aur issuer ko compensate is liye karte hain kyunki wo risk leta hai (cardholder pay kare ya na kare, merchant ko paise milte hain).
    05Reconciliation kya hai aur payment systems me ye itna painful kyun hai?
    Reconciliation matlab shaam ko hisaab milana — website (order records), payment gateway (PayPal) aur ledger, teeno me amount ek hona chahiye. Example: tumne $200 ki ghadi khareedi — paise gaye, order aaya, lekin kisi ek jagah $199 ya $201 likha ho to paise kahin atak gaye. Ye painful is liye hai kyunki croreon transactions pe teeno systems ke records milane padte hain, aur breaks nikalte hain: amount mismatch, ek jagah entry missing, timing difference (dusre din ki entry), ya duplicate entry. Double-entry bookkeeping se har transaction ke do hisse (debit/credit) track kiye jate hain taaki break ki wajah dhoondhna aasan ho. Reconciliation boring lagta hai, lekin bina iske paise kahan gaye, ye pata hi nahi chalega.
    06Hotspot account kya hota hai? Nike ke Prime Day sale wale example se samjhao.
    Hotspot account wo account hai jisme ek hi time pe bahut saare transactions aate hain — jaise Amazon Prime Day pe Nike ka sale: ek hi account pe lakhon orders ek saath. Us account ka balance update karne ke liye database row lock lagta hai, aur saare orders line me khade ho jate hain — ek hi row bottleneck ban jati hai. Normal din ye theek hai, lekin sale wale din ye khidki hi poora system slow kar deti hai. Iske 3 optimizations hain: rate limiting (ek time pe kitne requests aane do), sub-accounts (ek bade account ko chhote accounts me baant do), aur cache-first updates (balance pehle cache me update karo, database me baad me likho).
    07SWIFT kya hai — kya SWIFT se paise bheje jate hain?
    Nahi — SWIFT paise nahi bhejta, wo messages bhejta hai. SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication) duniya ke bankon ko jodne wala secure messaging system hai. America se London paise bhejne pe SWIFT ek 17-step message flow chalata hai: Bank A (New York) message bhejta hai, wo pehle local Regional Processor pe validate hota hai, phir central Slice Processor (sorting office) se hokar Bank B (London) tak pahunchta hai. Asli paise correspondent banks ke accounts ke beech move hote hain — SWIFT sirf ye batata hai ki kisne kisko kitna dena hai. Isi liye SWIFT ko bankon ka registered post kehte hain — chithhi le jata hai, paise nahi.
    08ACH payment kya hai aur UPI se kaise alag hai?
    ACH (Automated Clearing House) US ka batch payment system hai — salary aur bills isi se aate hain. UPI real-time hai (seconds me), ACH batch me kaam karta hai: transactions din bhar collect hote hain, raat ko process hote hain, aur paise agle din subah milte hain. Flow me ODFI (originating bank) aur RDFI (receiving bank) hote hain, aur cut-off time hota hai (jaise shaam 7 baje) — uske baad ki entry agle din jati hai. 2018 se Same Day ACH bhi possible hai, jisme funds usi din transfer ho sakte hain. ACH slow lekin sasta aur reliable hai — bulk payroll aur recurring bills ke liye perfect, jabki UPI instant person-to-person payment ke liye bana hai.
    09QR code payment ke 4 tareeke kaunse hain?
    Do sawaalon se 2×2 = 4 combinations bante hain: (1) QR kaun dikhayega — dukaan ya customer? (2) QR static hai ya dynamic (har baar naya)? Dukaan dikhaye + static QR — jaise counter pe chipka sticker (Paytm ka QR), customer scan karke amount daalta hai. Dukaan dikhaye + dynamic QR — har order ke liye naya QR jisme amount bhi ho. Customer dikhaye + dynamic QR — tumhare phone pe har payment ke liye naya code, dukaan scan karti hai (WeChat/Alipay aise karte hain). Customer dikhaye + static QR — tumhara fixed code. Paytm, WeChat, Alipay, PayPal — sab yahi 4 tareeke use karte hain.
    10Stop-loss order kaise kaam karta hai? $35/$36 wale example se samjhao.
    Stop-loss order ek safety net hai — jaise car ka airbag. Example: tumhare paas ABC Inc. ka stock hai, aur tum kehte ho ki agar market price $36 ya usse neeche gir jaye to bech do, taaki nuksaan limit me rahe. Jaise hi system detect karta hai ki price $35 ho gaya, wo turant ek market order banata hai aur exchange ko bhej deta hai — stock market price pe bik jata hai. Dhyan rakhne wali baat: stop-loss ye guarantee nahi deta ki stock $36 pe hi bikega — agar price tezi se gir raha ho to execution $35 ya usse neeche bhi ho sakta hai (slippage). Isi liye stop-loss ko limit order se alag samjho — limit order ek fixed price pe bikta hai, stop-loss trigger hone pe market order ban jata hai.
    11Bank ka digital wallet aur blockchain wallet me kya farak hai?
    Bank ka digital wallet custodial hota hai — bank tumhare paise rakhta hai aur ek account number deta hai (jaise Bob ka account B1234, jisme $100 deposit hote hain). Tum wallet app se paise bhejte ho, lekin asli movement bank ke andar hoti hai — Bob ke account se deduct hoke Alice ke account C512 me credit hota hai, aur settlement baad me hota hai. Blockchain wallet non-custodial hota hai — tumhare paas private keys hoti hain, paise seedha blockchain pe hote hain, aur transfer hone pe network khud verify karta hai (ETH jaise). Bank wallet me bank pe bharosa karna padta hai (aur bank band ho to paise atak sakte hain), blockchain wallet me keys kho gayi to paise hamesha ke liye gaye — dono ka risk model bilkul alag hai.
    12Payment system design karte waqt sabse pehle kya sochna chahiye?
    Pehle ye socho: paise galat hone pe kya hoga — kyunki payment me galti ka matlab seedha paison ka nuksaan hai. Is liye 4 cheezein design ke centre me rakho: (1) Idempotency — har request ke saath unique key, taaki retry pe double payment na ho; (2) Ledger as source of truth — har transaction double-entry bookkeeping se likho, taaki hisaab hamesha mil sake; (3) Reconciliation — roz apne records ko bank/gateway ke records se milao, breaks ko turant pakdo; (4) Failure modes — network timeout, payment fail, return/refund — har scenario ka flow pehle se design karo (jaise stock pehle reserve karo, payment success ke baad deduct karo). Inke baad scale, latency aur cost ki baari aati hai — pehle correctness, phir speed.
